stories.title: WWE reveals date & location for Crown Jewel 2026
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced that Crown Jewel 2026 will take place on Saturday, November 7th, in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as part of Riyadh Season. The date and location were revealed during the taped broadcast of the August 31 episode of Monday Night RAW and later promoted by Turki Al-Sheikh. The annual event typically highlights matches between the men and women champions from both the Raw and SmackDown brands for the Crown Jewel titles. In addition to this upcoming PLE, Riyadh is also scheduled to host WrestleMania 43 in 2027.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland says Kofi inspired his journey to AEW World title, Wembley main event
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland recently credited Kofi Kingston as a major inspiration behind his historic AEW World Championship win and his main event match against Bryan Danielson at AEW All In at Wembley Stadium. Reflecting on Kingston's legacy and impact on a generation of wrestlers, Strickland emphasized how watching Kingston's monumental WrestleMania moment fueled his own championship aspirations. This mutual respect culminated when Kingston and Xavier Woods debuted in AEW as The New Level, aligning with Strickland to capture the AEW World Trios Championship.

stories.title: Woman Deletes TikTok Account After Making Rey Fénix Affair Allegations
stories.tldr: A woman who recently accused WWE superstar Rey Fénix of having a secret affair has completely deleted her TikTok account. Her original posts featured alleged private messages, explicit conversations, flower deliveries, and intimate photographs matching Fénix's tattoos. Although she removed her content after the story spread across social media, numerous screenshots and screen recordings continue to circulate online. Neither Fénix nor WWE has publicly addressed the ongoing allegations.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff questions whether AEW can maintain New Level’s momentum
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Eric Bischoff has expressed doubts on his 83 Weeks podcast regarding whether AEW can maintain the momentum of Kofi and Austin Creed, now known as The New Level, following their debut at All In 2026. While praising the duo's energy and talent after they won the World Trios titles alongside Swerve Strickland, Bischoff warned that AEW has a recurring pattern of failing to properly utilize former WWE stars long-term. He cautioned that without meaningful creative integration and storylines, the newly signed tandem could fade into obscurity within three months. Meanwhile, Strickland and The New Level are already scheduled to defend their newly won titles against The Rascalz on the upcoming episode of Dynamite.

stories.title: Rumor Roundup (Sept. 1, 2026): New Level in AEW, Rhea Ripley return, All In timing, more!
stories.tldr: Recent wrestling rumors highlight Kofi and Austin Creed making a fantastic backstage impression following their surprising AEW debut at All In. Meanwhile, WWE is planning for Rhea Ripley's potential return at Wrestlepalooza in Perth and proactively securing work visas for AAA talent. Additional updates cover AEW's tight scheduling for All In to protect the main event time, backstage notes on Britt Baker missing call time, and confirmation that Nigel McGuinness worked through a legitimate foot injury.

stories.title: Rey Fénix’s Alleged Mistress Fires Back: “If He Doesn’t Care About His Family, Why Should I?”
stories.tldr: The woman accusing wrestler Rey Fénix of a secret affair has refused to apologize, instead shifting the blame directly onto the star. After leaking romantic messages, explicit chats, and photographic evidence linked to his verified Instagram account, she faced heavy criticism from social media users. Responding to a critic who accused her of destroying a family, she argued that if Fénix himself does not care about his family, she has no reason to either. Both Fénix and WWE have remained completely silent as the controversy continues to spread.

stories.title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 Announced For November 7th In Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced that the Crown Jewel Premium Live Event will take place on November 7th, 2026, in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This return to the capital city comes ahead of a historic milestone for the company, as Saudi Arabia is also scheduled to host WrestleMania in April 2027. The upcoming Crown Jewel event follows the tradition of high-stakes matches established in 2025, which featured champion-versus-champion bouts across both the men's and women's divisions.

stories.title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 Date, Location and Venue Revealed
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced that Crown Jewel 2026 will take place on November 6 at the Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The event is expected to follow a champion-versus-champion format similar to previous plans. If Roman Reigns and CM Punk retain their respective world titles until November, it could set up a blockbuster WrestleMania 42 rematch in Riyadh. While nothing is locked in and the card remains wide open due to the unpredictable nature of WWE title pictures, the potential clash between two of the company's biggest names is firmly on the table.

stories.title: Rey Fénix Accused of Secret Affair After Alleged Love Messages Surface
stories.tldr: Rey Fenix is facing a major personal scandal after a woman using the TikTok account yzbeth3 published videos detailing an alleged secret affair. The leaked material includes intimate photographs, flower deliveries, and direct messages from a verified Instagram account belonging to the wrestling star. In the messages, Fenix purportedly professes his love for the woman, references his brother Penta, and sends romantic song dedications.

stories.title: Hootie & The Blowfish’s Darius Rucker Defends Ric Flair’s Career, Calls Flair The GOAT
stories.tldr: Musician Darius Rucker recently took to social media to defend professional wrestling legend Ric Flair, declaring him the greatest of all time amid online criticism. When a user praised Kenny Omega versus Will Ospreay at AEW All In as the best match ever, Rucker countered that they clearly had never seen Flair versus Ricky Steamboat. Rucker, who is real-life friends with Flair, also expressed nostalgia for the territory days of professional wrestling and the deep emotional investment it created for fans.

stories.title: WWE RAW 8/31/2026: 3 Things We Hated & 3 Things We Loved
stories.tldr: The August 31, 2026 episode of Raw featured major developments like Penta defeating Fenix to challenge Roman Reigns, alongside a chaotic backstage and ringside brawl involving The Bloodline, OTM, and Royce Keys. Reviewers heavily criticized WWE for interspersing this male-focused parking lot attack directly into the entrance of the Women's Intercontinental Championship match, which overshadowed the division. However, they praised Sol Ruca for delivering a stellar, athletic performance against champion Raquel Rodriguez despite a chaotic, interference-heavy finish.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Famer Admits Oba Femi Makes Him Consider a Return
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mark Henry recently revealed that NXT standout Oba Femi is the rare modern talent who has made him consider coming out of retirement for one more match. Although Henry officially ended his full-time in-ring career in 2017 and previously dismissed comeback ideas due to age, injuries, and feeling he had accomplished everything, Femi's dominant presence changed his perspective. Henry admitted that if he were ten years younger and one hundred percent healthy, he would have loved to step into the ring to face the rising star.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff Says WWE's Cody Rhodes Is Hurting His Image With Podcast Gig
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Eric Bischoff recently expressed concern that Cody Rhodes hosting a podcast is damaging his wrestling image and reducing his star power. Bischoff argued on his podcast that top WWE superstars should maintain their mystique rather than overexposing themselves by interviewing others and peeling back the curtain. He compared the current era to the 1990s, noting that a peak Stone Cold Steve Austin would never have hosted a podcast during his prime. Ultimately, Bischoff believes these media ventures turn larger-than-life wrestling stars into ordinary people, which hurts long-term business.

stories.title: Alexa Bliss Reveals How Charlotte Flair Tag Team Was Pitched
stories.tldr: Alexa Bliss recently discussed how her unexpected tag team pairing with Charlotte Flair was first pitched to WWE management, noting that officials initially hesitated due to Flair's existing heel heat. Bliss believed the combination would work well because their contrasting television personas and real-life friendship offered a fresh dynamic for the audience. The duo eventually enjoyed a successful 100-day reign as WWE Women's Tag Team Champions and are now preparing for a major match at Sunday Night's Main Event alongside Tatum Paxley.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale Wants A Singles Match With Megan Bayne In AEW
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Willow Nightingale has expressed her desire to step into the ring for a one-on-one match with Megan Bayne. While the two competitors have previously collided on the independent scene and shared the canvas in various tag and multi-woman matches within All Elite Wrestling, they have yet to face each other in a singles bout on AEW television. Nightingale believes that a singles encounter between the two powerhouses would result in a hard-hitting contest where they would beat the heck out of each other.

stories.title: AEW All In 2027 Main Event
stories.tldr: Following the conclusion of the latest All In event, speculation has already begun regarding potential main events for the 2027 show. Analysts are looking at fresh matches that could break historical trends, such as the first-ever heel main event victory or the women division finally headlining a major pay-per-view. Prominent contenders include high-stakes title defenses, dream tag team encounters, and blockbuster cross-company or free agent showdowns.

stories.title: Brandi Rhodes on Cody Rhodes’ Neck Tattoo: “I Don’t Not Like It”
stories.tldr: Brandi Rhodes recently discussed her husband Cody Rhodes polarizing neck tattoo during an appearance on Shot of Brandi with Carmelo Hayes. While she does not hate the massive American Nightmare design, she admits she would have preferred a much smaller artwork on his neck. Brandi also expressed doubt regarding Cody's past claims that he did not realize the final tattoo would turn out to be so large.

stories.title: Alexa Bliss Reflects on Bray Wyatt’s Impact on Her Career
stories.tldr: During a recent appearance on Busted Open Radio, WWE star Alexa Bliss discussed the profound and lasting impact that the late Bray Wyatt had on her career and creative process. She explained how their partnership during the Thunderdome era shifted her perspective from simply delivering promos to viewing her on-screen persona as a living, breathing human with a complex past and future. Bliss noted that she still carries Wyatt's lessons with her today, from watching his recommended documentaries to honoring him with a special moth design and tribute at WrestleMania.

stories.title: Penta vs. Rey Fenix: Who Won WWE World Heavyweight Championship No. 1 Contender Match Revealed
stories.tldr: On the August 31 episode of WWE RAW, real-life brothers Penta and Rey Fenix faced off in their first WWE singles match during the finals of the World Heavyweight Championship No. 1 Contender Tournament. After a hard-hitting, high-flying battle that included a devastating table spot and multiple near falls, Penta ultimately secured the victory by hitting a Mexican Destroyer. With the win, Penta earned a championship match against reigning titleholder Roman Reigns, setting up a high-stakes face-off between the new challenger and the champion ahead of their upcoming bout in Mexico City.

stories.title: Brandi Rhodes Reveals Why Her WWE In-Ring Return Never Happened
stories.tldr: Brandi Rhodes recently revealed that she came close to making an in-ring WWE return in 2022 after spending two weeks training at the WWE Performance Center. Despite enjoying the workouts with veterans like Norman Smiley and Fit Finlay, she decided against a full-time comeback because her young daughter struggled significantly with her absence during training. Ultimately, the demanding travel schedule and the realities of motherhood led Rhodes to step away and forgo her planned return.

stories.title: Money in the Bank qualifying matches begin next week on WWE Raw
stories.tldr: WWE has announced that qualifying matches for the upcoming Money in the Bank premium live event will officially begin on next week's episode of Raw. The winners of these qualifiers will advance to the high-stakes ladder matches scheduled for October 10 in New Orleans, Louisiana. Last year's tournament winners, Naomi and Seth Rollins, both successfully cashed in their briefcases for world titles before eventually having to vacate them due to pregnancy and injury, respectively. In addition to the start of the qualifying matches, next week's Raw will feature a Women's World Championship defense where Liv Morgan puts her title on the line against Stephanie Vaquer.

stories.title: WWE Makes Money In The Bank Announcement, Title Match Set For 9/7 Raw
stories.tldr: WWE has officially launched the buildup for the upcoming Money in the Bank premium live event. Company officials announced that qualifying matches will officially begin on the September 7 episode of Monday Night Raw. Although specific participants and matchups have not yet been revealed, the road to the October 10 event is underway. In addition to the tournament buildup, a major championship match is set for next week with Liv Morgan defending the WWE Women's World Championship against Stephanie Vaquer.

stories.title: Money In The Bank Qualifying Matches Set For 9/7 WWE Raw
stories.tldr: WWE has announced that Money in the Bank qualifying matches will officially begin on the September 7 episode of Raw. While specific participants and matchups have not yet been revealed, the high-stakes bouts will start building the fields for the upcoming ladder matches. Additionally, the same episode is scheduled to feature a Women's World Championship match between champion Liv Morgan and challenger Stephanie Vaquer. Further updates and match announcements are expected leading up to the live broadcast.

stories.title: Hip-Hop Star Quavo To Perform Live At WWE Sunday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: Hip-hop star and lifelong wrestling fan Quavo will perform live at WWE Sunday Night's Main Event in his hometown of Atlanta, Georgia. The former Migos rapper is scheduled to open the September 6 show with an unreleased track from his upcoming album QROMELIFE. This appearance builds on Quavo's history with the company, which includes previous performances and crowd cameos. The star-studded event will also feature high-profile matches, such as Cody Rhodes taking on Randy Orton and Lil Yachty facing Baron Corbin.

stories.title: Roman Reigns Has Perfect Response to LA Knight Comparison With The Rock
stories.tldr: During the August 31, 2026, episode of WWE RAW, Roman Reigns confronted Solo Sikoa for aligning with LA Knight instead of returning to the Bloodline family. Reigns dismissed Knight by acknowledging that while he might remind Sikoa of The Rock, he is not actual family. The confrontation escalated when Knight interrupted to mock Reigns, leading to a backstage brawl where Reigns blindsided Knight with a Superman Punch.

The road to Money in the Bank is about to begin. WWE announced during the August 31 episode of RAW that the first qualifying matches will take place next week.

stories.title: Another Title Match Added to WWE RAW in Mexico City
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee has earned a major opportunity to challenge Chad Gable for the Intercontinental Championship when WWE RAW heads to Mexico City. Lee secured the title shot on the August 31 episode of RAW by defeating Ethan Page in a high-stakes match arranged by Gable. During the show, Gable expressed his desire to build a legacy with the title and initially offered Lee the match, which prompted an objection from Page. Following Gable's intervention against Page's illegal tactics, Lee capitalized on the distraction to hit his signature finisher and punch his ticket to Mexico City.

stories.title: Top Star Goes Too Far as WWE Cuts Off Mic on RAW
stories.tldr: During the August 31, 2026, episode of WWE RAW, Jacob Fatu delivered an uninhibited, expletive-filled promo directed at Royce Keys and OTM after they interfered in a match involving The Usos. Frustrated by their actions, Fatu climbed the announce table and used profanity live on air, prompting WWE production to abruptly cut his microphone and censor the broadcast. The incident adds fuel to the ongoing turmoil within The Bloodline storyline, which already features complex dynamics involving Roman Reigns and Solo Sikoa.

stories.title: Roman Reigns Attacks LA Knight Backstage After Solo Sikoa/Jacob Fatu Incident On WWE Raw
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns returned on WWE Raw to address his potential challengers and heavily criticized Solo Sikoa for aligning with LA Knight. LA Knight confronted Reigns in the ring, calling him a coward before the action shifted backstage where Solo Sikoa was found laid out. Knight investigated the scene and confronted Jacob Fatu, leaving himself vulnerable to a blindside attack from Reigns to close the segment.

stories.title: WWE Pixelates Blood in Multiple Segments on 8/31 RAW Broadcast
stories.tldr: During the August 31 broadcast of Monday Night Raw, WWE heavily sanitized the show by pixelating blood in multiple backstage segments and bleeping profanity. The censorship was clearly visible during a violent parking lot ambush involving Roman Reigns, LA Knight, The Usos, Royce Keys, and OTM, as well as during an attack on Solo Sikoa. This increased editing has sparked speculation over whether the production decisions were driven by WWE management or impending content standards for their upcoming move to Netflix.

stories.title: Netflix Butchers 8/31 WWE Raw Opening Segment With Horrible Edits
stories.tldr: Fans watching the August 31 episode of WWE Raw on Netflix noticed severe censorship and choppy editing during the opening segment featuring a parking lot brawl between Royce Keys and OTM and The Bloodline. The broadcast included blurred faces of The Usos and unexpected word censorship, continuing a troubling pattern of altered taped shows on the streaming platform. Viewers and critics are baffled by the edits, especially given that Netflix hosts numerous mature shows featuring violence and murder without issue.

stories.title: Dragon Lee Defeats Ethan Page On WWE Raw, Will Wrestle Chad Gable For Men's IC Title
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee earned a future Intercontinental Championship match against Chad Gable by defeating Ethan Page on WWE Raw. Gable had originally come to the ring to address the crowd before Lee and Page both staked their claims for a title shot. During the resulting singles match, late interference and an exposed turnbuckle backfired, allowing Lee to secure the victory with his finishing maneuver. Lee will now challenge Gable for the championship at an upcoming WWE event in Mexico City.

stories.title: Chad Gable’s Next Intercontinental Title Challenger Revealed During 8/31 WWE RAW
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee secured a shot at Chad Gable's Intercontinental Championship by defeating Ethan Page on the August 31 episode of WWE RAW. Page attempted to cheat by exposing a turnbuckle, but the distraction backfired and allowed Lee to hit Operation Dragon for the victory. This opportunity comes just one week after Lee missed out on a World Heavyweight Championship opportunity against Roman Reigns. The title match is officially set to take place on the September 14 episode of RAW.

stories.title: Brooke Hogan Threatens to Expose Family Screenshots After Linda Hogan’s Public Attack
stories.tldr: Brooke Hogan has issued a final warning to her mother, Linda Hogan, after Linda publicly accused her on Facebook of discarding the family like trash and shared old childhood photos. Brooke fired back on Instagram by threatening to release private screenshots that would expose the real reasons behind their estrangement. Fed up with her name being constantly dragged through the mud, Brooke warned that Linda's selective amnesia will no longer protect her from the truth.

stories.title: Dragon Lee Set To Challenge Chad Gable For Intercontinental Championship On 9/14 WWE Raw
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee has earned a shot at singles gold by becoming the number one contender for the Intercontinental Championship. After recently falling out of contention for the World Heavyweight Championship, Lee rebounded by defeating Ethan Page on the August 31 episode of Raw. He secured the victory with his Operation Dragon finisher after taking advantage of Page removing a turnbuckle pad. As a result, Lee will now challenge current champion Chad Gable for the title on the September 14 episode of WWE Raw.

stories.title: Raquel Rodriguez Beats Sol Ruca (With Some Help), Retains WWE Women's IC Title On Raw
stories.tldr: Raquel Rodriguez successfully defended her WWE Women's Intercontinental Championship against Sol Ruca on Raw, though she needed outside interference to secure the win. The match was initially delayed by an impassioned promo from Jacob Fatu following an earlier attack on the Bloodline. Despite a fierce back-and-forth battle that saw Ruca take out several members of The Judgment Day at ringside, Lyra Valkyria ultimately intercepted Ruca on the ropes. This distraction allowed Rodriguez to hit the Tejana Bomb and retain her title.

stories.title: WWE Censors Jacob Fatu’s F-Bomb Outburst on August 31 RAW
stories.tldr: During the August 31, 2026 episode of WWE RAW, Jacob Fatu delivered an unscripted and uncensored F-bomb outburst while hyping up the crowd after a brawl. Although his microphone was cut immediately during the taping, fans in attendance heard the explicit language loud and clear. When the segment finally aired on television, WWE applied a standard audio bleep and slightly trimmed the footage to remove the profanity and shorten his time on the announce table. While social media fans hoped the raw moment would air completely untouched, the edited broadcast ultimately toned down the intensity of the segment for home viewers.

stories.title: Phoenix Championship Wrestling Looks to Set Arizona Records with Anniversary 8 Featuring Home Grown Talent
stories.tldr: Phoenix Championship Wrestling is gearing up for the biggest independent wrestling event in Arizona history with their Anniversary 8 show on September 19th at Skyline High School in Mesa. Promoted by Dom Vitalli and Jon Wolfgang, the milestone event expects over 2,000 fans and showcases a powerful mix of nostalgic legends and rising local talent. The author reflects on how attending these local shows successfully restored their long lost passion and emotional connection to professional wrestling.

stories.title: Why John Cena Refuses to Release Unused WWE Heel Theme “Fear My Name”
stories.tldr: John Cena recently revealed that he recorded an unused heel entrance theme called Fear My Name and prepared a complete villainous persona that ultimately never made it to television. During a Q&A at Fan Expo Canada, Cena firmly shut down the idea of ever releasing the song to the public. He explained that releasing the material would only cause fans to obsess over an imaginary alternate career path rather than appreciating what actually happened. Cena wants to keep the creative process private while using the experience as a lesson to encourage younger talent to always overprepare.

stories.title: Brie Bella Opens Up About Serious Gut Health Concerns, Set To See Specialist
stories.tldr: Former wrestling star Brie Bella is addressing ongoing and worsening gut health issues on her podcast, despite previously making light of embarrassing incidents related to the condition. Although her recent medical tests show that her thyroid, liver, and overall levels are healthy, her gut health has declined significantly from a seven to a ten. She is now scheduled to see a specialist next week, with doctors raising the possibility that an underlying autoimmune disease may be affecting her digestive system.

stories.title: Alexa Bliss Discusses Bray Wyatt’s Influence On WWE Career
stories.tldr: WWE star Alexa Bliss recently discussed the profound impact her former partner Bray Wyatt had on her mindset and career during an appearance on Busted Open Radio. Bliss explained how Wyatt shifted her creative outlook from simply playing a heel to treating her character as a living, breathing human with a deep universe. She continues to honor his memory and creative influence today, including paying tribute to him with her WrestleMania gear.

stories.title: New AEW Signings After All In: London 2026
stories.tldr: Following Revolution Pro Wrestling's 14-Year Anniversary Show at OVO Arena Wembley ahead of All In: London, several standout independent and international talents are being eyed as potential future AEW signings. Because of existing partnerships, promotions like RevPro frequently showcase wrestlers ready for the global stage, highlighting tag teams like The Young Guns and high-flyers like Robbie X. Other notable names such as Drilla Moloney and members of CPF also represent the promising future of British wrestling talent.

stories.title: Vince Russo Claims Police Seized 700 Pounds of Drugs at Gathering of the Juggalos
stories.tldr: Former wrestling writer Vince Russo expressed extreme shock on The Coach and Bro Show after learning that law enforcement confiscated a staggering 700 pounds of drugs at this year's Gathering of the Juggalos. Held in Macks Creek, Missouri, the festival featured local police and task forces seizing massive quantities of illegal substances, including hundreds of pounds of marijuana and mushrooms within just the first two days. The event, which also hosted Juggalo Championship Wrestling alongside its music festivities, resulted in multiple arrests, including a vendor linked to the festival's ticketing site. Russo was left completely floored by the sheer scale of the contraband recovered during the four-day event.

stories.title: Men’s WWE Money In The Bank 2026 Entrants
stories.tldr: WWE is shaking up its schedule by holding the Money in the Bank premium live event on October 10, leaving a five-week window to establish participants through upcoming qualifying matches. This extended break gives creative teams ample time to build compelling storylines for the men's ladder match. Analysts are already speculating about potential entrants, including former holder Seth Rollins, hometown star Ricky Saints, and the surging babyface Solo Sikoa. These possible contenders represent diverse roster dynamics and fresh pathways to the main event picture.

stories.title: WATCH: Wrestler Spotlight: Marti Belle Credits Wrestling With Helping Her Learn English
stories.tldr: Professional wrestler Marti Belle recently shared how watching television broadcasts as a child in New York City helped her learn English before she could fully understand the spoken language. In a detailed interview, she discussed her transition from acting school to training at Gleason's Gym in Brooklyn, her partnership as one-half of The Hex with Allysin Kay, and her current role as the EMERGE Women's Champion. Belle also emphasized the deep personal motivation she draws from fulfilling her childhood dreams and providing crucial representation for young fans of color.

stories.title: Rhea Ripley’s Status for WWE Wrestlepalooza After Knee Surgery
stories.tldr: WWE is hopeful that Rhea Ripley will be able to travel to Australia for Wrestlepalooza on December 12 in Perth, though her status to actually wrestle remains uncertain. Ripley is currently in the early stages of recovering from knee surgery following a torn meniscus that required a procedure after failing to heal on its own. Recent footage showing her in a large knee brace and on crutches highlights the significant recovery time still ahead. Even if she is not cleared to compete by December, company officials expect her to make the homecoming trip to support the event.

stories.title: Next Holder Of Every AEW Championship Following All In London 2026
stories.tldr: Following AEW All In London at Wembley Stadium, which featured multiple title changes and set the stage for a new era, analysts are looking ahead to predict the next titleholders in the company. The projections cover various championships and feature a mix of rising stars, returning veterans, and potential high-profile debutants. Names like Nick Wayne, Hangman Adam Page, and Konosuke Takeshita are highlighted as future champions in upcoming storylines. These anticipated feuds aim to map out the landscape of All Elite Wrestling over the coming months.

stories.title: Watch: Danhausen Dresses As Cody Rhodes In Bizarre Segment At WWE Live Event
stories.tldr: Danhausen surprised Cody Rhodes at a WWE live event in North Charleston by dressing up as the champion with an exaggerated hairstyle and singing an untimely happy birthday. Joined by CM Punk, the bizarre in-ring segment also featured Ricky Saints receiving a cake to the face. The lighthearted moment continues Danhausen's tradition of comedic antics during non-televised WWE house shows.

stories.title: Jade Cargill Bringing Back “Baddie Section” For WWE Sunday Night’s Main Event
stories.tldr: Jade Cargill announced that her signature Baddie Section will return for the WWE Sunday Night’s Main Event at State Farm Arena in Atlanta on September 6. The concept, which originated during her time in AEW, features hand-picked fans seated together at ringside. Cargill stated she is bringing the feature back on her own terms as she prepares for a six-woman tag team match alongside Michin and B-Fab against Tatum Paxley, Alexa Bliss, and Charlotte Flair.

stories.title: Brandi Rhodes Reveals Why She Abandoned Plans For WWE In-Ring Return
stories.tldr: Brandi Rhodes has explained why she ultimately decided against pursuing an in-ring return to WWE after training at the Performance Center in the summer of 2022. Despite enjoying her time working with coaches and talent following the birth of her daughter Liberty, the emotional toll of being away from her child proved too difficult. Seeing how upset her daughter became after training made Rhodes realize she could not manage the grueling lifestyle of a full-time travelling wrestler. Although her in-ring career is behind her, she remains connected to the industry through her husband Cody Rhodes and recently shared her honest thoughts on his famous neck tattoo.

stories.title: WWE Legend Admits Oba Femi Is First Time He’s Considered Coming Out Of Retirement
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mark Henry recently revealed that NXT standout Oba Femi is the first wrestler to make him genuinely consider coming out of retirement. Although Henry officially concluded his full-time in-ring career in 2017 and previously weighed a 2019 match against Nick Aldis, he ultimately stayed retired due to age and lingering back and leg injuries. However, Henry admitted that if he were completely healthy and a decade younger, he would have loved to step back into the ring to face Femi in a major challenge.

stories.title: Jade Cargill Makes Tease For WWE Sunday Night’s Main Event: “I’m Bringing It Back Because …”
stories.tldr: Jade Cargill has announced that her signature Baddie Section is returning for WWE Sunday Night’s Main Event in Atlanta, Georgia. Taking to social media, Cargill stated she is tired of playing by the rules and is bringing the feature back because she owns it. The concept originated during her time in AEW and will make its WWE return on September 6 at the State Farm Arena. At the event, Cargill will team with Michin and B-Fab to face Tatum Paxley, Alexa Bliss, and Charlotte Flair in a six-woman tag team match.

stories.title: Brandi Rhodes reveals why she called off plans for WWE in-ring return
stories.tldr: Brandi Rhodes recently explained why she ultimately decided against making an in-ring return to WWE after training at the Performance Center in 2022. Although she enjoyed working with the coaches and roster, she realized she could not balance a full-time wrestling schedule with the demands of raising her young daughter. Rhodes has not wrestled an official match since leaving AEW in 2022 alongside her husband Cody, though she recently appeared during his WrestleMania 40 entrance. Looking ahead, she has a new reality show in development and welcomed her second daughter, Leilani, in 2025.

stories.title: Brandi Rhodes Explains Not Returning To WWE As Wrestler, Honest Thoughts On Cody Rhodes’ Neck Tattoo
stories.tldr: Brandi Rhodes recently revealed why she ultimately decided against making an in-ring return to wrestling after training at the WWE Performance Center in the summer of 2022. Although she initially intended to make a full-time comeback following the birth of her daughter Liberty, the immense challenge of balancing a grueling wrestling schedule and life on the road with motherhood proved to be too difficult. Despite stepping away from an active in-ring career, she has still made select appearances alongside her husband Cody Rhodes, including participating in his entrance at WrestleMania 40. During the same interview, she also shared her honest perspective on Cody's famous American Nightmare neck tattoo, admitting she would not have gotten it quite as large herself but respects that it reflects his bold personality.

stories.title: Danhausen Dresses As Cody Rhodes For Bizarre WWE Live Event Birthday Celebration
stories.tldr: Danhausen surprised Cody Rhodes at a WWE live event in North Charleston, South Carolina, by dressing up in a Cody-inspired outfit with a towering Guile-style haircut. Joined by CM Punk in the ring, Danhausen awkwardly serenaded Rhodes with a belated rendition of Happy Birthday. The lighthearted house show segment concluded with Ricky Saints getting a cake smashed into his face.

stories.title: Can’t Knock The Hustle: Let’s Crown Some New Champions (WWE/NXT Edition)
stories.tldr: An editorial column responding to a reader request outlines fantasy next champions for WWE and NXT titles rather than AEW due to upcoming pay-per-view unpredictability. The author emphasizes these choices are personal preferences for future storylines rather than strict predictions or criticisms of current titleholders. The two previously split two matches over the WWE Championship during Cena's 2025 retirement tour, trading victories at WrestleMania 41 and SummerSlam. stories.title: WWE Announces Special Music Performance To Open Sunday Night’s Main Event In Atlanta

Quavo is no stranger to the company, having previously made appearances at WWE Day 1, attended WWE Bad Blood, and interacted with top stars like Jey Uso on Raw. Fans can catch the live event streaming on Peacock in the United States and on YouTube internationally at 8 ET/5 PT.

stories.title: Musical performance to open WWE Sunday Night’s Main Event
stories.tldr: Rapper and lifelong WWE fan Quavo will open Sunday Night’s Main Event in his hometown of Atlanta with a performance of an unreleased track from his upcoming album QROMELIFE. The event airs live on Peacock and YouTube from the State Farm Arena. stories.title: ‘No Khan’ has the money to get John Cena to break his retirement vow
stories.tldr: John Cena recently addressed fans at Fan Expo Canada regarding persistent speculation that he might break his retirement vow for a massive payday. Responding to a One More Match chant, Cena stated that neither Nick Khan nor Tony Khan has enough money to make him return to the ring. He emphasized that coming back for ego-driven reasons would disrespect the fans who sacrificed their hard-earned money to attend his farewell tour. Ultimately, Cena insisted that his health is good, his closure is final, and he has no intention of ever wrestling again.

stories.tldr: Following a new TNA policy restricting its talent from competing against wrestlers from other major companies on independently promoted shows, a recent Leon Slater match at a RevPro event caused streaming complications. Although TNA president Carlos Silva initially faced fan backlash for allegedly blocking the broadcast on the MyAEW platform, it was revealed that RevPro owner Andy Quildan made the pre-emptive call to pull the match from the live stream to avoid political complications. Fortunately, the match will soon be released for free on YouTube, though the incident highlights ongoing tensions in the current pro wrestling landscape.

stories.title: John Cena says “No Khan has got the pocketbook” to bring him out of retirement
stories.tldr: During a recent appearance at Fan Expo Canada, John Cena firmly shut down any speculation about coming out of retirement in the future. He humorously noted that neither WWE executive Nick Khan nor AEW leader Tony Khan has enough money to convince him to return to the ring. Cena emphasized that returning for ego-driven reasons would mean breaking the trust of fans who saved up significant resources to attend his farewell tour. Ultimately, he feels great about his health, has achieved closure, and is completely finished taking bumps.

stories.title: John Cena Shuts Down AEW Or WWE Return: “No Khan .. Nick [Or] Tony, Got The Money. I’m Out!”
stories.tldr: John Cena firmly shut down any speculation of an in-ring return for WWE, AEW, or any other promotion during a recent appearance at Fan Expo Canada in Toronto. Addressing fans chanting for one more match, Cena joked that neither WWE President Nick Khan nor AEW President Tony Khan has enough money to lure him out of retirement. He emphasized that returning would disrespect the fans who sacrificed their hard-earned money to attend his 2025 farewell tour. Instead, Cena remains content with his career conclusion, focusing on his ongoing ambassador role with WWE under a strict no-fall-downs policy.

stories.title: John Cena: ‘No Khan’ has enough money to get me back in the ring

stories.title: Will Ospreay credits WWE Hall of Famer for being ‘one of the guys that put me over’
stories.tldr: During the AEW All In post show media scrum, Will Ospreay reflected on his historic 2015 PWG match against Kenny Omega and his journey in professional wrestling. He revealed that WWE Hall of Famer AJ Styles played a crucial role in his career by strongly advocating for him to get brought into New Japan Pro-Wrestling. Ospreay also shared his awe of watching Omega rise to prominence in New Japan and expressed deep gratitude for finally sharing the ring with him at the highest level years later.

stories.title: MVP says a lot of today’s wrestlers are ‘scared to be real heels’
stories.tldr: Following his recent long-term contract extension with All Elite Wrestling, veteran manager MVP has addressed a major issue he sees in the current wrestling landscape. On his podcast, MVP criticized modern talent for being afraid to play traditional villains and opting instead for the safety of being cheered or playing tweeners. He believes today's wrestlers lack the courage to go all in as true bad guys because they ultimately want the audience to like them.

stories.title: Royce Keys & OTM Warn The Bloodline After Attacking Solo Sikoa

The chaos continued later in the night when Solo Sikoa was also found bloodied backstage during a confrontation involving Roman Reigns and LA Knight. Following the carnage, Royce Keys and OTM released a chilling warning video featuring the beaten-down Sikoa, making it clear that the stable is far from finished with the group.

stories.title: AEW's Jeff Jarrett Compares Sting & His Son Steven Borden

Speaking on his podcast, Jarrett compared Steven's mannerisms, grin, and in-ring style directly to his legendary father. Jarrett also commended the 34-year-old rookie for starting his career later in life and praised his strong reception from the AEW audience.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff compares Kenny Omega vs. Will Ospreay to a Nasty Boys match

Bischoff compared the bout to a Nasty Boys hardcore match, criticizing its lack of rules, structure, and referee authority. Despite acknowledging the event's commercial success and praising the special entrances, he felt the in-ring action relied too heavily on sloppy high spots.

The rookie signing also coincides with AJ's recent in-ring retirement and transition to a backstage role with WWE.

stories.title: Joe Gacy Believes WWE Considered Him A Cheap Bray Wyatt Replacement
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Joe Gacy believes that management may have viewed his NXT cult-leader character as a budget-friendly replacement for Bray Wyatt following Wyatt's 2021 release. Although nobody within the company ever confirmed this suspicion to him, Gacy pointed to heavy involvement from Vince McMahon and John Laurinaitis, along with pitched wardrobe choices that closely mirrored Wyatt's early gear, as reasons for his concern. Fearing comparisons and determined not to become a watered-down imitation he dubbed Diet Wyatt, he frequently pushed back against creative proposals that felt too derivative. Gacy ultimately believes that had Vince McMahon remained in creative control, that specific version of his character likely would have eventually received a main roster call-up.

He waited until their non-compete clauses expired before reaching out through representation to finalize their shocking All In debut. Khan also detailed his decision to immediately pair the newly dubbed New Level with Swerve Strickland to make history at Wembley Stadium.

stories.title: Backstage News On Nigel McGuinness Dealing With Legitimate Injury Before & During AEW All In
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley defeated Nigel McGuinness at AEW All In in the Continental Challenge Cup final. It has now been revealed that McGuinness was dealing with a legitimate foot injury throughout the latter half of the tournament. He originally sustained the injury during his first-round match against Katsuyori Shibata, leading AEW to adapt the real-life medical issue into his television storylines. McGuinness bravely worked through the pain, defeating Hechicero and Kyle O'Reilly before ultimately falling to Moxley at Wembley Stadium.

stories.title: AEW Champ Will Ospreay Plans To Make Challengers 'Scratch & Claw' For Title Shot
stories.tldr: Fresh off his historic AEW World Championship victory, Will Ospreay has revealed his plans for how he will run his upcoming title reign. Speaking at the post-show media scrum, the newly crowned champion stated that he will not issue open challenges or hand out title shots. Instead, Ospreay expects future contenders to scratch, claw, and earn their opportunities through hard work and eliminator matches to keep the world title prestigious.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff believes AEW is pushing Sting’s son Steven Borden too early
stories.tldr: Don Callis recently attempted to recruit Steven Borden following his involvement with Darby Allin, but industry veterans are now questioning the young wrestler's rapid ascent. Eric Bischoff has publicly cautioned that AEW is pushing Sting's son into the spotlight far too soon. Bischoff pointed to Borden's heavily limited in-ring experience as a major risk to his long-term career development.

stories.title: Will Ospreay says AEW All In: London 2026 was “probably the best PPV that we’ve ever done”
stories.tldr: Following his historic AEW World Championship win at Wembley Stadium, Will Ospreay opened up about the immense mental toll and stress he faced heading into the event. During the post-show media scrum, he admitted to feeling terrified of letting people down and struggling with being away from his family during a difficult week. Despite those personal anxieties, he praised the energy of the UK wrestling weekend and boldly declared the event to be the best pay-per-view the company has ever produced.

stories.title: Backstage Report On Planned Date For WWE Royal Rumble 2027
stories.tldr: The 2027 Royal Rumble in Arizona has shifted to February to avoid NFL competition through WWE's partnership with ESPN. Recent reports indicate the event is tentatively scheduled for Saturday, February 6, placing it on the same weekend as AEW Dynasty in England. While discussions previously touched on turning the Rumble into a two-night spectacle, it is currently expected to remain a single-night show for 2027.

stories.title: AEW Champ Mercedes Mone Offers Injury Update Following All In Victory
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone defeated Willow Nightingale at AEW All In to capture the Women's World Championship, fighting through a broken nose sustained in the opening moments of the match. Speaking at the post-show media scrum, the new champion revealed she was rushed straight to medical staff for stitches immediately following her win. It was also disclosed that Nightingale wrestled the entire bout with a pre-existing broken left hand. It remains unclear at this time whether either competitor will need to take time off to recover from their respective injuries.

stories.title: New details on Nigel McGuinness’s injury during AEW Continental Challenge Cup | Exclusive
stories.tldr: Nigel McGuinness suffered a legitimate foot injury during his opening match against Katsuyori Shibata at the August 12 AEW Collision taping. Rather than pulling him from the tournament, AEW leaned into the injury as a major storyline leading up to his final against Jon Moxley at AEW All In. McGuinness managed to fight through the pain to defeat Hechicero and Kyle O'Reilly before ultimately tapping out to Moxley's ankle lock at Wembley Stadium.

stories.title: Grayson Waller Addresses Capturing World Title In WWE NXT: “I Didn’t Get Demoted …”
stories.tldr: Following his NXT Championship win at Heatwave, Grayson Waller addressed his return to the developmental brand in a post-show video. The newly crowned champion dismissed the notion that moving from the main roster to NXT was a demotion. Instead, Waller stated that he returned with the specific goal of winning the title and taking a calculated risk that paid off.

stories.title: Kofi & Austin Creed Comment On WWE Exit & AEW Arrival
stories.tldr: Former WWE stars Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed recently debuted as The New Level at AEW All In, immediately capturing the World Trios Championships alongside Swerve Strickland. During the post-show media scrum, the duo addressed their departure from WWE. They clarified that their exit stemmed from a natural parting of ways rather than reported pay cut disputes, and expressed excitement about joining AEW to be part of its premier tag team division.

stories.title: EC3 hospitalized due to leg infection
stories.tldr: Former TNA World Champion EC3 has provided an update from the hospital, assuring fans that he is doing fine despite being admitted for a severe leg infection contracted at a recent Gathering event. He is currently passing the time reading and watching Christopher Nolan films while awaiting a timeline for his eventual in-ring return. This marks his second major health scare involving an infection, following a similar hospitalization in 2021.

stories.title: Kevin Owens Injury Update After Being Helped Backstage At 8/30 WWE Live Event
stories.tldr: Following concerns sparked by footage of Kevin Owens limping backstage at a weekend live event, backstage reports have quickly clarified his physical status. Fans worried the recently returned star had suffered a fresh knee injury after his matches against The Miz in South Carolina. Fortunately, subsequent updates have confirmed that Owens is completely fine and avoided any actual physical harm.

stories.title: Britt Baker issues statement following her return to AEW at All In: London 2026
stories.tldr: Following her surprise masked return at AEW All In London to help Persephone win the TBS Championship, Britt Baker has broken her silence. Marking her first appearance since November 2024, Baker posted on social media to express her gratitude to fans. She also cryptically addressed online speculation regarding her backstage reputation when replying to a fan.

stories.title: 26 leftover thoughts about AEW All In 2026 | Opinion
stories.tldr: Following AEW All In 2026, commentary has shifted toward post-show production quirks, talent booking trajectories, and future roster speculation. Critics highlighted the broadcast missing the Kenny Omega and Will Ospreay post-match handshake for standard pay-per-view buyers, alongside praise for the four-hour runtime and a 15-minute bonus overrun. Additional takeaways include surprise reactions to Britt Baker return, concerns over the Hurt Syndicate's pre-show placement, and rumors surrounding potential signings like Ilja Dragunov.

stories.title: Positive news on Kevin Owens after WWE house show injury scare
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens is completely fine following an injury scare at a weekend live event where he appeared to be limping and needed assistance getting backstage. Wrestling observers have confirmed that the limping was merely part of his match performance and he sustained no actual injury. This comes as a major relief for the recently returned star, who has adjusted his mindset to appreciate every moment in the ring following a lengthy recovery from neck surgery.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné celebrated her AEW title win with Sasha Banks’ WWE theme
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone overcame a broken nose to defeat Willow Nightingale at Wembley Stadium and capture the AEW Women's World Championship. Following the historic victory, the newly crowned champion celebrated at a local afterparty by guest-DJing a set. During the celebration, Mone surprised fans by closing out her musical playlist with her iconic former WWE entrance theme, Sky's the Limit.

stories.title: Backstage Update On Why MVP Missed AEW All In: London
stories.tldr: MVP missed AEW All In: London despite The Hurt Syndicate competing on the pre-show. His absence was caused by recent changes to the United Kingdom visa process that prevented him from making the trip overseas. AEW is already taking steps to resolve these bureaucratic hurdles to ensure he can travel for future international events.

stories.title: Ric Flair Threatens Legal Action Over Stolen Robes, Fires Back At O.J. Simpson Comparisons
stories.tldr: Ric Flair is ramping up legal action against individuals attempting to sell his iconic wrestling robes without valid proof of ownership or receipts. After accusing a woman named Tiffany VanDemark of stealing five robes in Philadelphia, social media users compared his crusade to O.J. Simpson's 2007 memorabilia robbery conviction. Flair playfully fired back at the comparisons on X, telling critics he was heading to a bar and offering to buy drinks for anyone who brought a stolen robe to join him.

stories.title: Britt Baker Sends Emotional Message After AEW Return At All In: London
stories.tldr: Following her surprise return at All In, Britt Baker shared an emotional social media message expressing gratitude to her fans for sticking by her during a nearly two-year absence. The former champion addressed her supporters by writing that she missed them more than they will ever know and thanked them for never giving up on her. Her return also precedes the upcoming September 9 Rebel Heart edition of Dynamite, which will honor her longtime friend and former ally Rebel as she battles ALS.

stories.title: John Cena Teases Major Update On WWE’s John Cena Classic
stories.tldr: John Cena recently provided a promising update on the upcoming John Cena Classic tournament, noting that company officials have finalized all the operational details. While a December date was previously discussed, scheduling conflicts with an international event in Perth have left the exact timing uncertain. Additionally, new format details reveal that fans will vote to crown the tournament champion, and Cena firmly shut down any rumors of an in-ring return.

stories.title: Britt Baker sends message to fans after AEW All In 2026 return
stories.tldr: Following her surprise masked return and interference at AEW All In to help Persephone win the TBS Championship, Britt Baker broke her silence to express deep gratitude to her supporters. Baker had been absent from television since November 2024, fueling intense speculation regarding her status with the company. She is now preparing for a major month ahead, highlighted by a special tribute show for her friend Rebel on September 9 and a homecoming appearance in Pittsburgh on September 30.

stories.title: Ric Flair threatens legal action against people that have been selling his robes without authorization
stories.tldr: Ric Flair is threatening legal action and involving his Boston attorney against individuals attempting to sell his iconic wrestling robes without valid proof of ownership, specifically targeting Tiffany VanDemark for allegedly stealing five of them. In subsequent social media posts, Flair joked that his robes are worth more than houses, reminded people that grand larceny is a felony, and invited anyone with his stolen property to meet him at an airport bar for free drinks. The WWE Hall of Famer emphasized the growing importance of protecting his memorabilia as he gets older.

stories.title: John Cena gives update on WWE’s John Cena Classic
stories.tldr: WWE is moving forward with the upcoming John Cena Classic tournament, which will feature a mix of main roster and NXT talent. John Cena recently provided an update noting that all event details are now finalized behind the scenes, though an official announcement is still being withheld. Additional details reveal the tournament winner will be decided by a fan vote, and the previously rumored December date faces potential scheduling conflicts. Furthermore, Cena firmly reiterated that he will never return to the ring for another match.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Pays Tribute To Sasha Banks Persona At AEW All In Afterparty
stories.tldr: After capturing the AEW Women's World Championship at Wembley Stadium despite suffering a broken nose, Mercedes Mone celebrated her victory at a local afterparty. During the post-show festivities, the newly crowned champion stepped behind the DJ booth and treated fans to a nostalgic surprise. Mone closed her set by playing her former WWE entrance theme song, Sky's the Limit. She is set to bring her official championship celebration to this week's episode of AEW Dynamite.

stories.title: Former WWE star EC3 announces that he has been hospitalized
stories.tldr: Former TNA World Champion EC3 was hospitalized following a severe leg infection he contracted after attending a gathering in the woods. After initially being turned away and suffering through five days of worsening symptoms, he was finally admitted for treatment. He is currently resting in the hospital, passing the time by watching movies and asking fans to send positive vibes instead of text messages.

stories.title: AJ Styles Explains What Son Avery Styles Can Learn In TNA Wrestling
stories.tldr: AJ Styles is weighing in on his son Avery officially signing with TNA Wrestling while continuing to take independent bookings. The veteran father and current WWE backstage producer emphasized that TNA will give the teenage rookie crucial television experience, particularly in learning how to hit strict time limits and commercial breaks. Avery's fast-tracked entry into the business has sparked some industry discussions about paying dues, but promoters like Brett Lauderdale remain confident in his talent and growth.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale Issues Emotional Message After Losing AEW Women’s World Title
stories.tldr: Following her AEW Women's World Championship loss to Mercedes Mone at Wembley Stadium, Willow Nightingale shared an emotional statement on social media reflecting on the grueling encounter. Nightingale revealed she competed through the physical toll of the match, having already entered the event with a broken hand. Despite the heartbreaking defeat, the former champion vowed to eventually smile again and keep pushing forward.

stories.title: Joe Gacy Says WWE Pause “Killed Our Momentum,” Talks Alexa Bliss/Braun Strowman & Wyatt Sicks Reunion Plans
stories.tldr: Beyond the creative reluctance to feature the faction without Bo Dallas, Joe Gacy revealed that WWE rejected pitches for individual character vignettes and unused dialogue-heavy VHS tapes. The group had hoped to operate similarly to The Judgment Day by branching into separate storylines. Additionally, creative internally discussed eventually adding Braun Strowman and Alexa Bliss to the stable at various points.

stories.title: News regarding the impression Kofi and Austin Creed made with people backstage at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Following their debut as The New Level at AEW All In, Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed immediately won over the backstage locker room. Sources praised the duo for being humble, approachable, and eager to introduce themselves without any ego. Tony Khan also revealed that both wrestlers requested a heavy weekly schedule similar to Jon Moxley to prove their strong work ethic.

stories.title: AJ Styles explains how son Avery will benefit from joining TNA
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently weighed in on his son Avery joining TNA, emphasizing that the television environment will teach the rookie crucial skills like hitting time cues and working around commercial breaks. Avery will balance his new TNA commitments with independent dates, including an upcoming appearance at Wrestling Revolver. The teenager has already debuted in a TNA dark match against Brian Myers and is currently part of an on-screen storyline with Frankie Kazarian acting as a heel mentor.

stories.title: Former AEW Champion addresses All In loss: ‘Let’s keep pushing forward’
stories.tldr: Following her AEW Women's World Championship loss to Mercedes Mone at Wembley Stadium, former champion Willow Nightingale has broken her silence on social media. Nightingale addressed the defeat on X, reflecting on the physical toll of competing with a broken hand and giving her all. Despite the heartbreaking setback, she vowed to keep pushing forward and eventually smile again.

stories.title: What is being said about Kevin Owens potentially suffering an injury at a WWE live event
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens sparked injury concerns over the weekend after needing physical assistance to the backstage area following a live event match in South Carolina. Initial backstage reactions within the company varied, with some talent suspecting it was merely in-ring selling while others feared a legitimate setback. Fortunately, subsequent wrestling observer updates have clarified the situation and confirmed that Owens is completely okay with no actual injury.

stories.title: Injured Former WWE Title-Holder Addresses Rumors: “Reports Are Greatly Exaggerated …”
stories.tldr: Piper Niven is setting the record straight regarding speculation about her in-ring future. Niven has been sidelined since August 2025 due to a neck injury, and despite providing several updates on her recovery through social media, rumors recently surfaced suggesting that the WWE star had retired fr

stories.title: Will Ospreay Gets Emotional Reflecting On Historic AEW World Title Win At Wembley
stories.tldr: Following his historic AEW World Championship win over Kenny Omega at Wembley Stadium, a visibly emotional Will Ospreay admitted in the post-show press conference that the immense self-imposed pressure nearly overwhelmed him all week. He reflected on the significance of being the first British wrestler to win a major world title on home soil and praised Omega as the greatest wrestler of their generation. Looking forward, Ospreay expressed a desire to headline more big-money events while also addressing his complicated relationship with United Empire stablemate Callum Newman.

stories.title: New Level Open Up On WWE Departure & Reveal Major Reason Why They Joined AEW
stories.tldr: Formerly known as Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods in WWE, The New Level explained during the All In media scrum that they left because they had simply outgrown their relationship with the company. Austin Creed revealed that AEW's strong emphasis on tag team wrestling was the primary reason for their signing, a sentiment echoed by Kofi. Meanwhile, Swerve Strickland shared how Kofi's past WWE Championship win inspired his own career, and Tony Khan detailed waiting until their non-compete clauses expired before reaching out.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Gets Emotional Discussing AEW Women’s Title Win, Confirms Broken Nose & Stitches
stories.tldr: Following her AEW Women's World Championship victory over Willow Nightingale at Wembley Stadium, a visibly emotional Mercedes Moné addressed the media with a broken nose and fresh stitches. Moné suffered the injury early in the match but fought through it to secure the title and make history as a multi-promotion world champion. During the post-show press conference, she reflected on her journey, her desire to elevate women's wrestling, and her upcoming celebration on Dynamite.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff believes that New Day becoming New Level is “the cheap way out”
stories.tldr: Following their AEW debut as The New Level, former WWE stars Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed have drawn a critical reaction from WWE Hall of Famer Eric Bischoff. Speaking on his podcast, Bischoff slammed the team's name change and transition as the cheap way out, arguing that leaning into their former New Day identity is a derivative move. Drawing from his own WCW experience, Bischoff explained that talent should focus on building authentic, brand-new characters rather than trying to draft off past WWE equity.

stories.title: Tony Khan’s AEW All In Scrum: When He Began Talking To New Level, PPV Buys, “Best Week In AEW History”
stories.tldr: Following All In at Wembley Stadium, Tony Khan revealed during the post-show media scrum that the event set a company record for pay-per-view buys on HBO Max and generated a six million dollar gate. Khan detailed the timeline of when he finally contacted Kofi and Austin Creed after their free agency window closed, and confirmed that AEW will definitely return to Wembley in the future. He also discussed the Motor City Machine Guns signing, his perspective on the media landscape, and his thoughts on Will Ospreay's mainstream morning television appearance.

stories.title: Injured WWE star clarifies retirement rumors amid recovery
stories.tldr: Piper Niven was sidelined with a neck injury in August 2025. Despite her frequent health updates on social media, rumors began to emerge that she had retired from pro wrestling. Niven responded to a fan’s post on X asking the WWE star about the authenticity of the speculation. Niven denied retiremen

stories.title: Will Ospreay addresses ‘mind blowing’ AEW All In tribute featuring ghosts from his wrestling past
stories.tldr: Following his historic AEW World Championship victory over Kenny Omega at Wembley Stadium, newly crowned champion Will Ospreay reflected on a deeply emotional entrance tribute. Speaking at the post show media scrum, Ospreay discussed how surreal it was to encounter key figures from his career history, including Zack Sabre Jr, Ricochet, Jon Moxley, and his wife Alex Windsor. He also credited his mother for providing the powerful voiceover for the introductory vignette that chronicled his long wrestling journey.

stories.title: Mercedes Mone pays tribute to Sasha Banks at AEW All In afterparty
stories.tldr: Newly crowned AEW Women's World Champion Mercedes Mone celebrated her All In victory at a London afterparty by trying her hand at DJing and playing her old WWE Sasha Banks theme song. Despite suffering a broken nose during her title win over Willow Nightingale, Mone is still scheduled for a championship celebration on the next episode of Dynamite.

stories.title: Darby Allin Wins TNT Championship at AEW All In with Return of Sting
stories.tldr: At AEW All In from Wembley Stadium, Darby Allin defeated Kevin Knight in a brutal falls count anywhere match to capture his third TNT Championship, ending Knight's 140-day reign. The bout featured extreme high-risk spots, including a massive Coffin Drop through the stage truss and another onto a stretcher to avenge Knight's prior betrayal at Double or Nothing. The match also saw a surprise return from wrestling legend Sting and his son Steven Borden, who helped neutralize interference from the Don Callis Family. Post-match, Allin revealed that his first TNT title win meant even more to him than his first AEW World title because it gave him the insecure early-career confidence that he truly belonged in the company.

stories.title: AEW Announces Dynasty 2027 International Location and London O2 Show
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has officially announced that the 2027 Dynasty pay-per-view will take place on February 7 at the M&S Bank Arena in Liverpool, England, marking the company's first-ever event in the city and its earliest PPV date in history. Following the event, AEW will remain in England to host a February 10 episode of Dynamite at The O2 Arena in London, which will be the venue's first time hosting a Dynamite broadcast. This scheduling shift for Dynasty, moving from its traditional April window to February, has sparked speculation regarding how it might impact the 2027 calendar, including potential changes to the Revolution PPV and counter-programming strategies against WWE's WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia. Additionally, the company is expanding its international footprint with its upcoming AEW Grand Slam France tapings in Paris this October.

stories.title: MVP Contract Extension Details with AEW
stories.tldr: MVP has signed a long-term contract extension with All Elite Wrestling that runs through age 57, ensuring his future with the company as a manager, mouthpiece, and consultant. While he remains open to a final in-ring match likely taking place next year, he has largely stepped away from active wrestling and physical bumps. Meanwhile, MVP recently missed AEW All In at Wembley Stadium due to ongoing visa issues affecting his international travel. Despite his absence, his Hurt Syndicate stablemates Bobby Lashley and Shelton Benjamin successfully competed on the event.

stories.title: Rush Issues Statement on Absence from AEW All In
stories.tldr: AEW star Rush has issued a public statement addressing his absence from the AEW All In 2026 event. Despite joining the company in 2022, El Toro Blanco has yet to compete on the promotion's biggest stage at Wembley Stadium. Rush expressed maturity and gratitude regarding the situation while confirming that he remains focused on his future opportunities. He has been absent from television since early July following a series of high-profile matches earlier in the summer.

stories.title: Tony Khan Explains Signing Motor City Machine Guns
stories.tldr: Tony Khan recently explained that signing the Motor City Machine Guns, Chris Sabin and Alex Shelley, was an easy decision once they became available as free agents. Khan, a longtime fan of the legendary tag team, seized the opportunity to debut them in front of their hometown fans in Detroit before bringing them to AEW television at All In. There, they immediately inserted themselves into the world tag team title picture by confronting champions Adam Copeland and Christian Cage. Now positioned alongside top tier teams like FTR and The Young Bucks, Sabin and Shelley are poised for a major championship chase in AEW.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher Recreates Shawn Michaels Spot at All In
stories.tldr: At AEW All In: London, Kyle Fletcher defended the International Championship in a triple threat match against Don Callis Family stablemates Kazuchika Okada and Konosuke Takeshita. Fletcher paid homage to Shawn Michaels by immediately landing a surprise superkick on Okada to kick off the bout, echoing the famous WWE Survivor Series 2009 betrayal spot. Despite a hard-fought 13-minute contest featuring nearfalls and attempted screwdriver tactics, Okada ultimately pinned Fletcher following a Rainmaker to capture the title. Following the match, Don Callis joined the celebration, and Okada forced a defeated Fletcher to raise his hand in acknowledgement of the new champion.

stories.title: Bryan Danielson Returns at AEW All In Zero Hour
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Champion Bryan Danielson made a surprise return during the Zero Hour pre-show at AEW All In at Wembley Stadium. Danielson joined the announce desk ahead of the TBS title match and reflected on previously winning the world title at the venue against Swerve Strickland. He had been away from television since April due to physical wear and tear that prompted Tony Khan to grant him time off to heal.

stories.title: The New Level (Kofi Kingston & Austin Creed) Debut in AEW at All In
stories.tldr: Former WWE stars Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed debuted as The New Level at AEW All In, teaming with Swerve Strickland to capture the World Trios Championships on their very first night. During the post-show media scrum, the duo explained their departure from WWE and the inspiration behind their new team name. Additionally, Tony Khan revealed that he waited until their non-compete clauses expired before unexpected contract talks came together just in time for the pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Wins AEW World Championship at All In
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay defeated Kenny Omega in a brutal main event at AEW All In 2026 to capture the AEW World Championship at Wembley Stadium. The historic victory made him the first English wrestler to win a world title on home soil after surviving a grueling match filled with massive kick-outs and near-falls. Following the emotional triumph, Ospreay opened up about the immense pressure he felt, while mainstream recognition rolled in including a congratulatory message from Assassin's Creed UK.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Breaks Nose at AEW All In in Women's World Championship Win
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone captured the AEW Women's World Championship at Wembley Stadium by defeating Willow Nightingale, though she suffered a broken nose in the opening moments of the match. Mone fought through the injury to force Nightingale to pass out in the Statement Maker after a chaotic, hard-hitting bout. The victory makes Mone the first woman to hold world titles in AEW, WWE, and CMLL.

stories.title: Jamie Hayter Comments on Britt Baker's All In Return and Tag Championship Win
stories.tldr: At AEW All In, Jamie Hayter and Alex Windsor captured the Women's Tag Team Championships from Divine Dominion to thrill the Wembley Stadium crowd. Britt Baker also made a surprise return on the pre-show, leading Hayter to address their complicated history and potential future interactions. The Brawling Birds ended the former champions' 168-day reign with their Two Birds One Stone finisher.

stories.title: AEW All In 2026 Reviews and Ticket Sales Updates
stories.tldr: AEW recently wrapped up its All In 2026 event at Wembley Stadium, drawing nearly 45,000 distributed tickets and closing with Will Ospreay capturing the world championship. Critical reception highlighted major moments like Britt Baker's return and the debut of Austin Creed and Kofi, alongside mixed reactions to the pre-show. Additionally, early ticket sales figures have emerged for upcoming autumn events like All Out, WrestleDream, and Full Gear.

stories.title: Kenny Omega on All In Title Loss and Passing Torch to Will Ospreay
stories.tldr: Following their highly anticipated rubber match at Wembley Stadium, Will Ospreay defeated Kenny Omega in the main event of AEW All In 2026 to capture the AEW World Championship. Ospreay made history as the first English wrestler to win a major world title on home soil by kicking out of the One-Winged Angel and securing the pin. In the aftermath, Omega publicly passed the torch to the new champion on social media.

stories.title: Kazuchika Okada Wins International Championship at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Kazuchika Okada captured the AEW International Championship at Wembley Stadium by defeating Kyle Fletcher and Konosuke Takeshita in an all-Callis Family triple threat match. The chaotic bout ended when Okada hit the Rainmaker on Fletcher following a flurry of near-falls and stablemate miscommunication. Post-match tensions arose before Don Callis intervened to force Fletcher into raising Okada's hand. The blockbuster event also featured a wave of other championship changes and surprise returns across the card.

stories.title: Britt Baker Returns at AEW All In to Help Persephone Win TBS Title
stories.tldr: Despite reports claiming she would miss the event, Britt Baker made a surprise return at AEW All In London during the Buy In pre-show. Disguised in a mask, Baker interfered in the TBS Championship match, pushing Maya World off the top rope to help Persephone secure the victory and the title. After the match, Baker locked World in the Lockjaw and unmasked to a massive ovation from the Wembley Stadium crowd, later revealing an alliance with the new double champion.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Wresltes at RevPro Before AEW All In
stories.tldr: Following his surprise appearance at Revolution Pro Wrestling the night before AEW All In, Will Ospreay and Tony Khan have addressed the high-stakes decision. Ospreay explained that honoring his roots and supporting RevPro owner Andy Quildan was super important to him, especially given their history together. Khan admitted that Ospreay played with fire by wrestling so close to headlining Wembley Stadium, but ultimately trusted the star's judgment. The gamble paid off, as Ospreay successfully competed at both events and captured the AEW World Championship.

stories.title: Post-AEW All In Dynamite Lineup Announcements
stories.tldr: Following the conclusion of All In, AEW announced the initial match card and segments for the upcoming post-PPV edition of Dynamite in Texas. Newly crowned AEW World Trios Champions Swerve Strickland and New Level will defend their newly won titles against The Rascalz. Additionally, newly minted Women's World Champion Mercedes Mone will host a special championship celebration segment.

stories.title: Cope & Cage Defeat Young Bucks at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland and Christian Cage successfully defended the AEW World Tag Team Championship against The Young Bucks at All In following a hard-fought battle at Wembley Stadium. After Christian used a loaded elbow pad and Copeland delivered a decisive Spear to secure the win, the champions were immediately confronted in the ring. Motor City Machine Guns, a returning FTR, and the newly crowned trios champions New Level all staked their claim for a future title opportunity.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo Wins Casino Gauntlet Match at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo triumphed in the Casino Gauntlet match at AEW All In, entering as the very first participant to set a new match record. After surviving an eleven-person field that featured a chaotic sequence involving MJF and Nick Wayne, Andrade stole the winning pinfall. He has now earned a guaranteed future opportunity at the AEW World Championship against the winner of Kenny Omega versus Will Ospreay.

stories.title: Jon Moxley Wins Continental Challenge Cup at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley successfully defended his Continental Championship and won the inaugural Continental Challenge Cup against Nigel McGuinness at AEW All In. In a hard-fought battle at Wembley Stadium, Moxley targeted his opponent's injured ankle throughout the 17-minute bout. Ultimately, Moxley forced McGuinness to submit to a grueling ankle lock after delivering a curb stomp. The emotional match concluded with a rousing ovation from the London crowd for McGuinness.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Expresses Gratitude to Tony Khan for Surgery Costs
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay has revealed that AEW President Tony Khan personally covered the astronomical cost of his neck surgery last year, which totaled over $420,000. While Ospreay noted he could have afforded the procedure himself, Khan's financial support deeply impressed him and highlighted the promoter's care for his talent. This continues a pattern of Khan paying for major medical procedures for both contracted and non-contracted wrestlers, including Mark Davis, Eddie Kingston, and The Blade.

stories.title: Thekla Makes Return at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Thekla officially made her surprise return to AEW during the All In Zero Hour pre-show at Wembley Stadium following the TBS Championship match. Interrupting the broadcast panel, she declared her comeback and teased that things in the company are about to get Toxic again. Her appearance ends an absence that began after she lost the women's title in July.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale All In Tribute Plans
stories.tldr: Following the recent passing of music legend Dolly Parton at age 80, tributes have poured in from across the wrestling industry. AEW star Willow Nightingale is now planning a unique tribute to Parton and Tim Curry at the upcoming All In event in London. During her match against Mercedes Mone, Nightingale will adopt a campy, elevated look to honor the late icons. She stated that the ultimate way to pay respect to them is to spread kindness and be herself.

stories.title: Jackson Drake Wins NXT North American Title & Myles Borne Turns Heel
stories.tldr: At WWE NXT Heatwave, Myles Borne suffered a disastrous night by losing both of his championships to the faction Vanity Project. First, Borne and Tavion Heights dropped the NXT Tag Team Championship to Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes, and later, Borne lost the NXT North American Championship to Jackson Drake following outside interference. Frustrated by the losses and the collapse of his title reign, Borne shockingly turned heel by attacking his tag partner Heights with his Borne Again finisher. The betrayal leaves Heights laying in the ring and sets up an explosive new feud between the former friends.

stories.title: Kevin Owens Injured/Helped Backstage at WWE Live Event
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens was helped backstage and appeared to be limping following his match at a WWE live event in South Carolina. Local footage captured the veteran receiving assistance, sparking concerns over a potential knee injury just weeks after his return to the ring. WWE has not yet officially confirmed the nature or severity of the situation. This latest scare comes on the heels of a long layoff due to a complex neck surgery that nearly ended his career.

stories.title: WWE NXT Halloween Havoc 2026 Date Announced
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced that NXT Halloween Havoc 2026 will take place on Saturday, October 31, marking the first time the historic event is actually held on Halloween night. NXT General Manager Robert Stone revealed the date during a backstage segment at the Heatwave Premium Live Event. The show will air live on The CW, though WWE has not yet announced a host city or venue.

stories.title: Zaria Unifies NXT Women's North American and Speed Championships at Heatwave
