During his run with the promotion, which lasted until 2011, Nash formed close bonds with younger talent and enjoyed memorable storylines before eventually making a brief return to WWE.

stories.title: Zach Gowen explains conditions for participating in Dark Side of the Ring
stories.tldr: Former professional wrestler Zach Gowen initially turned down an offer to appear on Dark Side of the Ring because he did not want to reopen old wounds without purpose. However, after his wife convinced him of the show's importance and producers agreed to his financial terms, he reconsidered. Gowen ultimately agreed to participate only after ensuring the documentary would prominently feature his modern-day recovery and redemption rather than solely focusing on his past mistakes.

stories.title: Awesome Kong open to potential wrestling comeback
stories.tldr: Former WWE and AEW star Awesome Kong, also known as Kia Stevens, is leaving the door open for a potential professional wrestling return. During a recent interview, she explained that while wrestling is not her primary focus, she would consider stepping back into the ring if someone helped her get back into shape. Kong last wrestled in September 2023 and is currently evaluating her next professional steps as she approaches her 49th birthday.

stories.title: Mustafa Ali suffers punctured lung and fractured ribs at TNA Lockdown, pulls from events
stories.tldr: TNA International Champion Mustafa Ali recently suffered a punctured lung and fractured ribs, forcing him to withdraw from upcoming independent bookings in Australia and Scotland. Backstage reports have clarified that the injury occurred during a routine bump in his Lockdown match against Jason Hotch rather than a high-risk cage dive. Despite being hospitalized, Ali appeared on TNA Impact to offer Hotch a truce and a chance to rejoin the Order 4 faction. TNA has no plans to strip Ali of his championship, and a match between Hotch and Trey Miguel is set to determine the next title challenger.

stories.title: Matt Cardona vows rapid return following triceps surgery
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona recently suffered a torn triceps during a Main Event taping against Kit Wilson in Toronto. Despite the significant setback, the 41-year-old star has undergone surgery and vowed to return faster than expected. Cardona remains determined to re-establish his momentum and chase his ultimate goal of becoming WWE Champion.

stories.title: Retrospective look at pro wrestling title changes on August 28
stories.tldr: Beyond historic title changes, August 28 boasts an impressive catalog of critically acclaimed matches throughout pro wrestling history. Top-rated encounters include brutal deathmatches and a star-studded 2015 six-man tag team bout praised for its non-stop action and stellar heel work. Additional championship changes from promotions like AAA, NWA, and ROH further flesh out this busy date on the wrestling calendar.

stories.title: Bully Ray suggests TNA push AJ Francis despite potential controversy
stories.tldr: Wrestling legend Bully Ray is urging TNA to give AJ Francis a major push despite acknowledging that the polarizing star often rubs people the wrong way. Speaking on Busted Open Radio, Ray highlighted Francis's improved physique, strong promo skills, and ability to generate genuine heat. Francis recently wrapped up a feud with Elijah at Lockdown and is looking for a breakthrough opportunity after two years with the company.

stories.title: AAA preparing for Ola de Calor Global event broadcast times
stories.tldr: General Manager Rey Mysterio has announced a major triple threat match for the upcoming AAA Ola de Calor event on August 30, 2026, featuring Jack Cartwheel, Nathan Frazer, and Mini Vikingo battling for the top contendership to the Latin American Championship. The show will emanate from the Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, taking place immediately before NXT Heatwave. Officials have now released the complete global broadcast schedule so international fans can plan their viewing times.

stories.title: MJF Comments on Modern Wrestling, Veterans, and Tribalism
stories.tldr: Ahead of AEW All In, top star MJF shared candid thoughts across recent media appearances regarding the state of modern professional wrestling, locker room veterans, and industry tribalism. He criticized the homogenized style of modern matches, warned young wrestlers not to trust locker room veterans, and addressed media bias while urging fans to focus on positivity rather than toxic tribalism. His comments also highlighted rising company talents and evaluated competitive counter-programming from WWE.

stories.title: Mercedes Martinez Announces Retirement Following Injury
stories.tldr: Veteran professional wrestler Mercedes Martinez has announced her immediate retirement from in-ring competition after suffering a torn ACL during an August 15 match against Allie Katch for 2CW. The injury prematurely ended her planned Last Run Tour, which was roughly three-quarters of the way through her final year of a 26-year career. Although she is heartbroken that her career is ending this way and will require surgery, Martinez made it clear that she is only stepping away from active wrestling and plans to remain involved in the industry.

stories.title: Jessie McKay (The IInspiration) Announces Pregnancy
stories.tldr: Former WWE Women's Tag Team Champion and current AEW star Jessica McKay has announced that she is four months pregnant with her second child. Known to fans as Billie Kay or one half of The IIconics alongside Cassie Lee, McKay shared an Instagram video revealing that she and her husband are expecting a baby girl. This will be their second child, following the birth of their son Cooper in December 2023.

stories.title: Fire Breaks Out Near Wembley Stadium Days Before AEW All In
stories.tldr: A massive fire broke out at an industrial waste facility less than a mile from Wembley Stadium just two days before AEW All In. The London Fire Brigade responded with 20 fire engines and 125 firefighters to battle the large blaze, which produced heavy smoke and prompted local residents to shelter indoors. The incident caused notable disruptions to local Tube and rail services, though officials have confirmed that Wembley Stadium was not damaged and the upcoming wrestling event faces no threat of cancellation.

stories.title: Tony Khan Promises Runtime Details for AEW All In: London
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan has revealed a fixed four-hour runtime for the upcoming AEW All In: London pay-per-view main card to accommodate local venue curfews at Wembley Stadium. The event will begin at 1 PM Eastern with the main card ending by 5 PM Eastern, preceded by a Buy-In pre-show starting at 11 AM Eastern. Meanwhile, the promotion has also announced an updated match lineup for the massive event, featuring high-profile title defenses and tournament finals.

stories.title: Luchasaurus Provides Comeback Timeline After Fourth Surgery
stories.tldr: AEW star Luchasaurus has provided an optimistic recovery timeline, aiming for a late October return after undergoing his fourth surgery of the year. He has been sidelined since December due to shoulder injuries sustained during a battle royale and subsequent television angles. His extensive medical setbacks have included operations on both rotator cuffs, a left meniscus, and a right elbow.

stories.title: Wrestling Rumor Roundup: Bloodline, New Day to AEW, Omega Absence
stories.tldr: Recent reports indicate that the ongoing Bloodline storyline in WWE is currently planned to continue through WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia, though potential financial hurdles and Dwayne Johnson's movie schedule remain variables. Meanwhile, former New Day members Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed are widely expected by internal sources to make their AEW debuts this weekend at All In in London. Additional rumors cover backstage updates on Kenny Omega, injuries to Kyle O'Reilly, potential roster moves for Ilja Dragunov, and an expanded role for Cathy Kelley in WWE.

stories.title: Matt Hardy Criticizes AEW Stars for Excessive No-Selling
stories.tldr: Veteran wrestler Matt Hardy recently discussed the ongoing debate surrounding excessive no-selling in All Elite Wrestling during his podcast. He specifically pointed to high-profile stars like Will Ospreay, Swerve Strickland, and The Young Bucks for utilizing the tactic too frequently during fast-paced sequences. While Hardy acknowledges that no-selling has a valid place in professional wrestling history when used in moderation, he believes it loses its impact when performers completely ignore devastating moves. Ultimately, he feels that the modern style often prioritizes non-stop action and movement over essential selling.

stories.title: Nick Jackson Reflects on the Journey of All In
stories.tldr: Ahead of AEW All In: London at Wembley Stadium, Nick Jackson shared an emotional social media post reflecting on the incredible journey of the event since its 2018 independent origins. He expressed gratitude for the fans supporting The Young Bucks throughout their career as the duo prepares to face Adam Copeland and Christian Cage for the AEW World Tag Team Championship. Jackson also acknowledged how the original concept far exceeded his wildest dreams by becoming a signature annual showcase for AEW.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Reveals Tony Khan Considered Making Him AEW World Champion
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay recently revealed that AEW CEO Tony Khan seriously considered having him win the AEW World Championship at last year's marquee All In event. Khan ultimately went with "Hangman" Adam Page instead, a decision Ospreay initially found slightly frustrating before realizing it was a blessing in disguise. Shortly after the event, Ospreay discovered he had two herniated discs in his neck that required surgery, meaning he likely would have had to vacate the title immediately. Following a successful return to action in March 2026, Ospreay now prepares to challenge Kenny Omega for the world championship.

stories.title: Maya World Praises AEW's Mental Health Support
stories.tldr: Maya World recently opened up about the profound personal tragedy she faced when her brother passed away in a car accident in June. Despite this heartbreak, she channeled her grief into her career, recently capturing the TBS Championship at the Redemption pay-per-view. In a recent interview, she expressed deep gratitude to All Elite Wrestling for the overwhelming support and love shown to her. Specifically, she revealed that the company extended valuable mental health resources to both her and her family during this difficult time.

stories.title: Kenny Omega's Cleaner Heel Turn Ahead of AEW All In
stories.tldr: Kenny Omega revived his Cleaner persona and turned heel on AEW Dynamite by attacking Will Ospreay through a table with the One-Winged Angel. Reports indicate Omega made this drastic shift to provide Ospreay with a clear villain to overcome, ensuring their upcoming encounter feels like a true crowning achievement. The two competitors will collide with the AEW World title on the line at AEW All In on August 30.

stories.title: AEW Star Inspired by All In London Matches
stories.tldr: AEW star Lee Moriarty recently shared that he feels inspired by two marquee matches scheduled for the upcoming All In event at Wembley Stadium. Although he is absent from this year's pay-per-view card, Moriarty remains focused on hard work, timing, and preparation to prove he is the best pure technical wrestler in the world. He previously appeared on the Zero Hour pre-show at last year's event as part of Shane Taylor Promotions. Roster depth and limited spots on the stacked card mean Tony Khan faces ongoing challenges fitting all deserving talent onto the major international show.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman Says Will Ospreay Regrets Shot at The Rock
stories.tldr: Former WWE personality Jonathan Coachman believes Will Ospreay already regrets taking a jab at Dwayne The Rock Johnson ahead of AEW All In. During an appearance on ITV Good Morning Britain, Ospreay bragged that The Rock has never main evented Wembley Stadium, a milestone Ospreay is set to achieve against Kenny Omega. Coachman argued that Ospreay picked the wrong person to provoke, noting that The Rock only missed Wembley because WWE did not run major stadium shows there during his era. Furthermore, Coachman used the moment to criticize AEW President Tony Khan for lacking creative writers and storylines that allow top talent to generate buzz organically.

stories.title: Jamie Hayter Comments on Misogyny in Professional Wrestling
stories.tldr: AEW star Jamie Hayter recently spoke with the BBC about the ongoing evolution and challenges of women in professional wrestling. She highlighted the inherent misogyny within the industry and how female wrestlers have continually proven their ability to deliver great matches and promos. Additionally, Hayter opened up about her recent ADHD diagnosis, describing it as a relief that helps her better understand how her brain works.

stories.title: AEW All In Match Card Updates, Rumors, and Trios Title Match
stories.tldr: Tony Khan has officially announced a seven-team Trios Roulette Royale for the Buy-In pre-show at All In, featuring champions Hangman Adam Page and Brodido defending against the Bang Bang Gang, the Dogs, the Demand, the Death Riders, the Conglomeration, and one yet-to-be-revealed wildcard team. Speculation is high that former WWE stars Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods could fill that mystery spot. Additionally, backstage reports indicate that a multi-women ladder match is expected to be added to the main card.

stories.title: Eddie Kingston Cleared Following Health Scare
stories.tldr: Eddie Kingston has broken his silence regarding the recent health scare that forced him out of his scheduled AEW match against Claudio Castagnoli. Speaking during a media call, the veteran wrestler stated that he feels one thousand times better and is ready to get back to work. While he did not reveal the specific nature of the medical issue, he confirmed that all his checks came back clear. He is now locked in for his upcoming CMLL World Heavyweight Championship match against Hechicero.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher Discusses Guilt Over AEW Singles Push
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher has admitted that he experienced significant guilt over his breakout AEW singles push while his Aussie Open tag team partner Mark Davis was sidelined with an injury. Fletcher worried that his success would leave his best friend behind, though those concerns eased once Davis returned and successfully carved out his own singles and trios success. Looking ahead, Fletcher remains open to eventually reuniting Aussie Open in the future, noting that an evolved version of the team would likely look entirely different from their past run.

stories.title: AEW Expected to Pursue Ilja Dragunov After WWE Departure
stories.tldr: Following his WWE departure due to a breakdown in contract negotiations over financial demands, Ilja Dragunov is heavily rumored to be pursued by AEW. Backstage sources indicate that formal talks and a future debut could happen if negotiations progress smoothly. AEW President Tony Khan has also publicly praised the athlete, while talent like Kyle Fletcher have expressed excitement about a potential in-ring reunion.

stories.title: Ric Flair Misses Cauliflower Alley Reunion Due to Health Issues
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair was forced to miss the Cauliflower Alley Club's 60th annual reunion in Las Vegas due to a blood clot in his leg. Scheduled to receive the prestigious Iron Mike Mazurki Award, Flair instead addressed the crowd via a video message while wrestling legends Jerry Lawler and Jimmy Hart accepted the honor on his behalf. Although the medical issue prevented him from making the long trip to Las Vegas, Flair insisted that he is feeling great and expressed his gratitude to the organization. Despite the setback, The Nature Boy quickly pushed forward with his travel plans, heading to the airport just a day later to make a scheduled public appearance in Philadelphia.

stories.title: WWE Plans Bigger Backstage Role for Cathy Kelley
stories.tldr: WWE is reportedly planning to expand backstage correspondent Cathy Kelley's role due to her impressive work and strong internal popularity. Officials want to make her a focal point for upcoming social media campaigns and the social aspects of Club WWE, leveraging her digital strengths beyond standard TV interviews. While Kelley has previously expressed openness to a managerial role, she has ruled out ever having an in-ring wrestling match.

stories.title: Mick Foley Shirt Stolen at UK Charity Auction
stories.tldr: During his UK tour stop in Birmingham, Mick Foley held a charity auction for the Cauliflower Alley Club where two fans won his worn shirts with a 900 pound bid. After getting the items signed and taking photos with Foley, the two men fled the venue without paying a penny. Foley is now giving the culprits a couple of days to return the shirts and make a partial donation before he exposes their identities using extensive venue camera footage. Despite the theft, alternative fan donations ultimately helped raise $600 for wrestlers in need.

stories.title: Trish Stratus Reflects on WWE Career, Friendships, and Bullying
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus recently reflected on her legendary career during an extensive interview. She discussed her close friendship and instant chemistry with Lita, as well as the bullying she and Lilian Garcia faced from a mean locker room as newcomers. Stratus also looked back on high-profile moments like following The Rock versus Hogan at WrestleMania 18 and turning a ridiculous Thanksgiving Gravy Bowl match into a memorable spot. Ultimately, she emphasized making the most of every opportunity while noting she will only return to the ring for the right opponent and timing.

stories.title: Lineup and Notes for Taped Friday Night SmackDown
stories.tldr: WWE is set to broadcast a taped episode of Friday Night SmackDown originating from the Rocket Arena in Cleveland, Ohio, featuring a loaded lineup for the build toward Sunday Night's Main Event. Women's Champion Chelsea Green will make her in-ring return wearing a bedazzled mask after suffering a broken orbital bone, teaming with Tiffany Stratton to face Nia Jax and Lash Legend. The show also includes a WWE Women's United States Championship match between titleholder Jacy Jayne and Paige, alongside appearances from top stars like CM Punk, Kevin Owens, Cody Rhodes, and Randy Orton.

stories.title: WWE Announces Wrestlepalooza PLE Return in Perth, Australia
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced the return of Wrestlepalooza for 2026, heading to the RAC Arena in Perth, Australia, on Saturday, December 12. The event anchors a new three-year partnership between WWE and the Western Australian Government running through 2028, featuring annual weekend takeovers with SmackDown, the Premium Live Event, and Raw. Fans can purchase three-event combo tickets starting September 10, with the weekend also featuring extensive fan experiences, superstores, and VIP packages available through On Location.

stories.title: Nick Hogan Teases Hulk Hogan Sports Bar Near MSG
stories.tldr: Nick Hogan recently provided an update on the upcoming Hulk Hogan-themed SLAM sports bar located across the street from Madison Square Garden, revealing that an official opening date announcement is expected within the next couple of weeks. The multi-story venue has taken on deeper meaning for the family following Hulk Hogan's passing, featuring immersive interactive elements like hyper-realistic life-size statues and extensive wrestling memorabilia. Furthermore, Nick noted that WWE has shown massive excitement for the project and offered the venue as an auxiliary space for the company to use during events at MSG.

stories.title: NXT Women's Champion Kendal Grey Dealing with Ear Injury Ahead of Heatwave
stories.tldr: NXT Women's Champion Kendal Grey has revealed she is not at one hundred percent heading into her upcoming title defense due to a lingering ear injury sustained against Lola Vice. Despite experiencing ongoing balance issues and ringing in her ear following a violent collision with the ring steps, Grey has been aggressively undergoing rehab to prepare for the event. She acknowledges that challenger Kelani Jordan will likely target her compromised ear, but the champion remains entirely focused on doing whatever it takes to retain her title.

stories.title: WWE NXT Heatwave Preview and Analysis
stories.tldr: WWE NXT Heatwave 2026 is scheduled for Sunday, August 30, at the Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, featuring six matches with five championships on the line. The main event showcases NXT Champion Tony D'Angelo defending his belt in a fatal four way against Cruz Montana, Grayson Waller, and the debuting Zilla Fatu. Editorial commentary highlights a mix of high intrigue and creative concerns across the card, particularly regarding title unifications and challenger builds.

stories.title: Shawn Michaels Gives Update on Tatanka's Son Following WWE Tryout
stories.tldr: WWE Senior Vice President Shawn Michaels recently shared a positive update regarding Joseph Chavis, the son of wrestling veteran Tatanka, following a tryout over SummerSlam weekend. Michaels praised Chavis for doing a really good job and expressed excitement about his future progression. Chavis has been preparing for his career by training at Nattie Neidhart's exclusive Dungeon facility under the guidance of WWE star Jacob Fatu. While an official WWE contract has not yet been confirmed, Michaels' remarks suggest a signing could be on the horizon.

stories.title: Potential Netflix and Peacock Partnership Impacting WWE
stories.tldr: Netflix and Peacock are currently in preliminary discussions regarding a potential streaming partnership that could involve Netflix acting as a hub for other services. While rumors suggested that WWE programming like Saturday Night's Main Event might individually jump to Netflix, Dave Meltzer clarified that the show is not moving on its own. Instead, any theoretical shift would only occur if Peacock itself is integrated into the Netflix platform as part of this broader bundling concept.

stories.title: Joe Hendry's WWE Raw Absence
stories.tldr: Joe Hendry has been absent from Monday Night Raw since early August because he is filming a live-action micro-drama project for mobile platforms. Reports indicate this project is the first initiative in a new partnership between WWE and ReelShort that was announced earlier this summer. Hendry is involved in these vertical video projects optimized for mobile viewing, alongside fellow stars Drew McIntyre and Jacob Fatu. The new drama series featuring Hendry is slated to premiere sometime this fall.

stories.title: Nick Hogan Addresses Family Drama with Sister Brooke
stories.tldr: Nick Hogan recently addressed his relationship with his sister Brooke, insisting that the family is in a really good place despite recent public drama. His comments follow a painful situation surrounding WrestleMania weekend, where Hulk Hogan was honored with a statue and Nick was in attendance while Brooke was left out. Brooke publicly revealed she never received a direct invitation from WWE, learning later that the invite was supposedly routed through her brother. Although Nick avoided addressing the missed invitation controversy, he proudly highlighted Brooke's recent personal and professional milestones.

stories.title: Bully Ray Expresses Doubts on Big Cass' WWE Return
stories.tldr: Hall of Famer Bully Ray recently discussed Big Cass's WWE return, expressing that he is not yet fully convinced by the star's current run. While praising Cass's incredible physique and expressing personal happiness for his return, Ray criticized his recent match against Je'Von Evans as plodding and typical of old-school big men. Cass is currently portraying a more serious character focused on dominating opponents rather than relying on his past catchphrases with Enzo Amore.

stories.title: WWE Wraps Filming on Live-Action Microdrama
stories.tldr: WWE has officially wrapped filming in Los Angeles for its new vertical live-action microdrama produced in partnership with ReelShort. The project required top talent like Drew McIntyre, Joe Hendry, and Jacob Fatu to step away from television programming over the course of the summer. With production now complete, McIntyre and Hendry are expected to make their long-awaited returns to television in the near future. The short-form mobile series, which also features microdrama stars Marc Herrmann and Chase Mattson, is slated for an early fall premiere.

stories.title: CM Punk Co-Stars in New Netflix Movie 'The Bodyguard'
stories.tldr: Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk is transitioning to the silver screen by co-starring in the upcoming Netflix romantic comedy Guarding Stars, scheduled for release on November 18, 2026. Based on Catherine Center's 2022 novel The Bodyguard, the film was retitled from its source material to avoid confusion with the iconic 1992 Kevin Costner and Whitney Houston movie. Punk will appear alongside a notable cast featuring Leighton Meester, Jared Padalecki, and Andie MacDowell in a holiday-themed story about a bodyguard protecting a superstar actor.

stories.title: Hall of Famer Expresses Interest in Match Against Rhea Ripley
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus recently expressed strong interest in facing Rhea Ripley during an interview with Chris Van Vliet. While discussing potential dream opponents from the current roster, Stratus showed the most enthusiasm for a fan suggestion of Ripley, confidently stating that she could take her. Ripley has been sidelined since early June following knee surgery, while Stratus has maintained a part-time in-ring schedule. Stratus noted that she would only make another return if the timing and opponent made sense and she could give it one hundred percent.

stories.title: AEW Star Recalls Advice to CM Punk Regarding WrestleMania Main Event
stories.tldr: An AEW star has revealed the advice they gave to CM Punk about missing out on the main event of WrestleMania back in 2013. Mick Foley recalled telling Punk that stealing the show against The Undertaker mattered more than official card placement or top billing. Foley emphasized that true success and memorable moments are defined by the performers themselves rather than corporate placement. Punk has since gone on to feature prominently in WrestleMania main events during his later career.

stories.title: Chad Gable Praises The Undertaker's Leadership
stories.tldr: WWE Intercontinental Champion Chad Gable recently praised The Undertaker for his backstage leadership and producer role in AAA, highlighting how the wrestling legend's mentorship transformed his recent El Grande Americano storyline. Gable explained that Undertaker helped him achieve a profound mental shift, allowing him to abandon rigid planning and instead rely entirely on instinct and emotion during matches. Believing that this unique philosophy could change the modern locker room, Gable suggested that Undertaker sharing these insights with the main roster could spark a major revolution in WWE.

stories.title: Jinder Mahal Recalls Stress of Wrestling in Front of CM Punk
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Jinder Mahal recently revealed that performing in front of CM Punk during their earlier time in the company caused him significant anxiety. Mahal explained that Punk held a very high standard and was vocal about critiquing matches from the backstage area. However, Mahal also attributed Punk's intense demeanor back then to the grueling WWE schedule and the immense pressure of being a top main event star. He noted that upon Punk's return to the company in late 2023, the veteran appeared to be a completely different and much happier person due to a more manageable schedule.

stories.title: Court Hearing Canceled for WWE's Ludwig Kaiser
stories.tldr: A scheduled court hearing for WWE star Marcel Barthel, known as Ludwig Kaiser and El Grande Americano, was canceled in Orange County, Florida, regarding a misdemeanor battery charge from May. Barthel previously turned himself in and pleaded not guilty, and he continues to perform for WWE under a masked persona. He is still scheduled to appear on October 19 for a hearing on his motion to dismiss the case under Florida Stand Your Ground law.

stories.title: Santos Escobar Recalls Pitching LWO Idea to Triple H in NXT
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Santos Escobar recently revealed that he originally pitched the Latino World Order concept to Triple H during their time in NXT, though the idea was initially rejected in favor of Legado Del Fantasma. Years later, Escobar and his stablemates joined forces with Rey Mysterio when the legendary faction was officially revived on the main roster. Beyond reflecting on his faction history and his eventual 2023 heel turn, Escobar also voiced his strong desire for wrestling promotions to hire more Latino writers and producers to ensure authentic representation.

stories.title: NXT's Thea Hail Reveals Alopecia Diagnosis
stories.tldr: WWE NXT Superstar Thea Hail has publicly announced her diagnosis with alopecia areata, an autoimmune disease that causes the immune system to attack hair follicles and leads to sudden hair loss. Maintaining her sense of humor, she shared the news on social media alongside photos of herself with and without hair. Hail has been with the company since 2022 and most recently wrestled on the August 18 episode of NXT.

stories.title: Shawn Michaels Discusses NXT Roster Turnover
stories.tldr: Shawn Michaels recently addressed the unprecedented amount of roster turnover NXT has experienced as numerous talents moved to Raw and SmackDown throughout 2026. Despite leaving the men division initially shell-shocked, the brand successfully weathered the rebuilding phase thanks to key additions like Mike Santana, Grayson Waller, and Zilla Fatu. Michaels praised the roster for stepping up under immense pressure and believes the brand is regaining its momentum as it heads toward the end of the year and into 2027. He also commended NXT Champion Tony D'Angelo while discussing the criticism surrounding his current title reign.

stories.title: WWE Files Trademark and Prepares Main Roster Plans for Zilla Fatu
stories.tldr: WWE has filed a trademark for the Zilla Fatu name and is already making internal plans for a swift call-up to the main roster. Reports indicate his recent Raw vignette served as a soft introduction to the broader audience, with long-term plans to integrate him into the Bloodline storyline alongside his cousins. Dwayne The Rock Johnson has also publicly acknowledged Fatu ahead of his upcoming NXT title match.

stories.title: WWE Cancels Planned AAA Event at Hammerstein Ballroom
stories.tldr: WWE has scrapped plans for a live AAA event and television tapings that were scheduled for November 14 at the Hammerstein Ballroom in New York City. The date has been removed from the Manhattan Center internal calendar as company officials decided to shift their New York market focus to WrestleMania 43 weekend instead. As part of that updated strategy, AAA Eternal Glory will take place in April 2027 at the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden.

stories.title: WWE Files Trademark for Recently Debuted Superstar
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu is preparing for a high-stakes four-way championship match at NXT Heatwave following his explosive arrival on the brand. Ahead of the event, WWE officially filed a trademark application for his ring name with the USPTO. The filing covers wrestling exhibitions, media performances, and entertainment services. Additionally, the rising star has just received his very first official WWE merchandise release.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman Criticizes WWE Unreal Rehearsal Footage
stories.tldr: Continuing his recent critiques of modern wrestling operations, Jonathan Coachman is now questioning WWE's decision to air rehearsal footage on the Netflix series WWE Unreal. He argues that showing wrestlers working through matches beforehand ruins the element of surprise for fans and contradicts the strict security measures used during his own tenure. Coachman joins other veterans like The Undertaker in expressing concern over how much of the behind-the-scenes process is now being exposed.

stories.title: Mustafa Ali Injured and Cancels Upcoming Appearances
stories.tldr: TNA International Champion Mustafa Ali suffered fractured ribs and a punctured lung during his championship victory against Jason Hotch at TNA Lockdown 2026. As a result of the serious injury, Ali has withdrawn from his scheduled independent bookings in Australia and Scotland for September. TNA has not announced a timetable for his in-ring return, but a match between Trey Miguel and Jason Hotch is set to determine the next number one contender for his title.

stories.title: TNA Vacates X-Division Title and Announces 6-Way Match for Bound For Glory
stories.tldr: TNA Director of Authority Santino Marella announced that the X-Division Championship is officially vacant after Leon Slater exercised Option C to challenge TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth. To crown the new champion, TNA will host a six-way match at the Bound For Glory pay-per-view event on October 11, 2026, at the Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida. Competitors for this high-stakes match will earn their spots through a series of qualifying matches on upcoming episodes of TNA Impact. This major shake-up follows Slater's dramatic Last Man Standing victory over Cedric Alexander at TNA Lockdown, where he successfully preserved his historical legacy before chasing the company's top prize.

stories.title: Former WWE Star Velveteen Dream Involved in Boxing Press Conference Brawls
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Patrick Clark, known as Velveteen Dream, snapped during a pre-fight press conference ahead of his boxing debut against social media personality Ryan Pownall at Duel Arena 1 in Orlando. After Pownall mocked Clark's career trajectory by claiming he went from historic wrestling arenas to competing in mall food courts, Clark lunged at him and briefly grabbed a metal pole before security intervened. Clark was ejected from the venue, though footage later captured him returning to crash the stage and destroy set pieces. The event takes place at the Kia Center, a card originally scheduled to be headlined by Mike Perry and Dillon Danis before Danis withdrew.

stories.title: Matt Hardy Teases Chasing AAA Tag Titles
stories.tldr: Former TNA World Tag Team Champion Matt Hardy recently teased a potential pursuit of the AAA World Tag Team Championship alongside his brother Jeff. Speaking on his podcast, Hardy expressed interest in capturing the lucha libre promotion's titles amidst the current cross-promotion landscape involving TNA, WWE, and AAA. This discussion follows a busy period for both promotions, including the War Raiders holding the AAA titles and Matt and Jeff recently losing their TNA tag team championships.

stories.title: Profile on UK Independent Wrestler Nathan Cruz
stories.tldr: Nathan Cruz spent a decade working his way up from a council estate to the brink of a WWE contract, only for a sudden medical diagnosis to end his in-ring career before he could sign. Though he watched his peers succeed from a balcony in heartbreak, he eventually found a fulfilling path working behind the scenes in production for major wrestling events. Today, he remains a foundational figure in British wrestling, realizing that his career was ultimately a success despite taking an unexpected turn.

stories.title: NOAH Star RYUSEI Misses Shows Due to COVID-19
stories.tldr: Pro Wrestling NOAH competitor RYUSEI was forced to miss scheduled events on August 22nd and 23rd after contracting COVID-19. The 27-year-old Los Tranquilos de Japon stable member last wrestled for the promotion on August 10th. RYUSEI originally debuted alongside stablemates Tetsuya Naito and BUSHI at NOAH The New Year 2026.

stories.title: Hiroyoshi Tenzan Reflects on Satoshi Kojima Leaving NJPW for AJPW
stories.tldr: Hiroyoshi Tenzan recently reflected on his legendary tag team partner Satoshi Kojima leaving New Japan Pro-Wrestling for All Japan Pro Wrestling in 2002. Tenzan admitted he was shocked and felt betrayed by the move, attempting unsuccessfully to talk Kojima out of it because he believed their TenKoji partnership had much more to achieve. Decades later, the historic duo recently collided in Tenzan's retirement match on August 15th at the G1 Climax semifinals, where Kojima ultimately emerged victorious.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Title Changes on August 28
stories.tldr: August 28 holds a notable place in professional wrestling history with 256 major title changes recorded on this date across various promotions. Historical highlights include the Ultimate Warrior capturing the WWF Intercontinental Championship in 1989, Diesel and Shawn Michaels winning the WWF Tag Team Titles in 1994, and Kevin Nash claiming the WCW World Heavyweight Championship in 2000. More recent milestones feature Alexa Bliss winning the WWE RAW Women Championship in 2017 alongside various championship changes and vacancies spanning international promotions over the decades.

stories.title: EMERGE Wrestling Streams Full Show on YouTube
stories.tldr: EMERGE Wrestling is currently streaming its complete EMERGE 98: Back In The Saddle event for free on YouTube following its August 1 show from the Bartholomew County Fairgrounds in Columbus, Indiana. The broadcast features a high-stakes main event where EMERGE World Champion Brayden Lee successfully defended his title against Erik Surge and Ashton Adonis in a chaotic Triple Threat match. The card also includes a stacked lineup of matches, such as a tag team title defense by the Dead Presidents and an Outbreak Championship bout. Fans can watch the full event replay online to catch all the action and major post-match developments.

stories.title: Wrestling Community Pays Tribute to Actor Tim Curry
stories.tldr: The professional wrestling community is mourning the loss of legendary actor Tim Curry, whose iconic and eccentric roles left a massive impact on many stars. Wrestlers such as Nic Nemeth, Shotzi Blackheart, Frankie Kazarian, and Taya Valkyrie took to social media to share personal memories and pay tribute to his diverse career. Additionally, several talents noted the profound sadness of losing both Curry and music icon Dolly Parton in the same week.

stories.title: Zoey Stark (Zoey Serrano) Debuts in TNA
stories.tldr: Zoey Serrano has officially debuted in TNA Wrestling following her departure from WWE earlier this year. During the August 27 episode of Impact, she aligned with Daria Rae by launching a surprise attack on Indi Hartwell. Serrano has officially signed with the company and is already set for in-ring action on next week's program.

stories.title: TNA Impact Recaps and Match Results
stories.tldr: Following the Lockdown pay-per-view, M by Elegance defeated Jada Stone to become the first-ever TNA Knockouts Television Champion. In the main event, Nic and Ryan Nemeth successfully defended their World Tag Team Titles against Leon Slater and Ricky Sosa. Meanwhile, injured TNA International Champion Mustafa Ali offered Jason Hotch a return to Order 4, setting up a number-one contender match between Hotch and Trey Miguel for next week.

stories.title: Bully Ray Praises TNA Signing Avery Styles
stories.tldr: Bully Ray is praising TNA for signing second-generation star Avery Styles, calling the promotion an ideal developmental environment where WWE can also keep an eye on his progress. Ray noted that while Avery's debut cleverly plays into his father AJ Styles history with the company, the rookie must eventually carve out his own identity to escape a massive shadow. Meanwhile, fans have identified that Avery's newly released entrance theme is a mash-up remix of AJ's former themes from TNA and Ring of Honor, as the young wrestler prepares for upcoming TV tapings.

stories.title: The Hardys' TNA Tag Team Title Loss at Lockdown
stories.tldr: Following their TNA World Tag Team Championship loss to Nic and Ryan Nemeth at Lockdown, Matt Hardy revealed the strategic reasons behind the title change. Beyond Jeff Hardy's travel restrictions preventing him from entering upcoming Canadian tapings, the decision was designed to elevate Nic Nemeth as a top heel. TNA ultimately plans to use this momentum to build toward Leon Slater eventually defeating Nemeth and becoming the youngest World Champion in company history. Additionally, the main event suffered a frustrating six-minute cut due to the show running long.

stories.title: Updated Lineup For Tonight’s Episode Of WWE SmackDown
stories.tldr: Following last week's ratings momentum, WWE has finalized the match card for tonight's taped episode of SmackDown from Ottawa, Canada. The USA Network and Netflix broadcast will feature a high-profile tag team match and a Women's United States Championship defense. Fans can also expect addresses from top stars including Cody Rhodes, CM Punk, and Kevin Owens.

stories.title: VertVixen signs contract with AEW/ROH
stories.tldr: Independent wrestling standout VertVixen has officially signed a contract with AEW and Ring of Honor, fulfilling a long-held career goal after years of grinding on the independent scene. While reports confirm she is now part of the roster following questions raised about her promotional work for AEW All In in London, the exact structure of her deal remains under wraps. It is currently unconfirmed whether she has secured a full-time salaried agreement or is operating on a per-appearance basis. Having previously accumulated over two dozen dates across AEW and ROH since her initial appearances began in 2021, VertVixen has recently become a regular fixture on ROH programming and has competed on AEW Collision.

stories.title: AEW Continental Challenge Cup finals set for All In
stories.tldr: The finals of the inaugural AEW Continental Challenge Cup are officially set for AEW All In at Wembley Stadium, where reigning Continental Champion Jon Moxley will defend his title against Nigel McGuinness. Moxley punched his ticket by defeating his Death Rider stablemate Claudio Castagnoli, while McGuinness fought through an ongoing ankle injury to submit Kyle O'Reilly. This Sunday showdown marks a historic clash, as Moxley and McGuinness step into the ring together for the first time in twenty years.

stories.title: Logan Paul takes shots at Tommaso Ciampa and AEW
stories.tldr: While visiting a doctor's office for a torn triceps injury, WWE star Logan Paul spotted a framed photograph of former colleague Tommaso Ciampa and launched into a profanity-laden rant labeling him a traitor for joining AEW. Paul dismissed Ciampa's current employment by claiming that wrestling outside of WWE does not matter. The vlog also touched on Paul's injury recovery timeline and debunked rumors of backstage friction between Paul and his stablemate Bron Breakker.

stories.title: Will Ospreay opens up about body dysmorphia, ADHD, and personal struggles
stories.tldr: AEW star Will Ospreay recently opened up to Muscle and Fitness about his past struggles with body dysmorphia, autism, and an ADHD diagnosis he received at age 27. He recalled how a critical tweet in 2017 triggered intense insecurity about his physique, leaving him too embarrassed to ask his jacked peers for workout advice. Ospreay eventually overcame these hurdles by following structured online programs and hiring a personal trainer, while also gaining vital insight into how neurodivergence shaped his earlier career mistakes.

stories.title: Entrants declared for AEW All In Casino Gauntlet match
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Champion Chris Jericho and former AEW National Champion Mark Davis have officially declared themselves for the Men's Casino Gauntlet match at AEW All In in London. They join a field of competitors that includes Andrade El Idolo, MJF, Tommaso Ciampa, and Komander all vying for a future world title opportunity. While MJF and Andrade are guaranteed to enter as the first two participants, the unpredictable nature of the gauntlet means the match can end at any time before later entrants can even reach the ring.

stories.title: AEW Collision TV ratings and viewership updates
stories.tldr: AEW Collision experienced a slight drop in total viewership for the second straight week, falling below the 400,000 mark to 397,000 viewers for the August 22, 2026 episode on TNT. Despite the dip in total audience from the previous week's 409,000, the key 18-49 demographic rating remained steady at 0.06. Both the total viewership and demo numbers still outperformed the show's rolling 10-week averages and showed a significant year-over-year increase compared to the same week in 2025.

stories.title: Tony Khan says he supported Adam Copeland vs. John Cena match
stories.tldr: Tony Khan recently stated that he would have supported a final match between Adam Copeland and John Cena if a concrete proposal had been presented during Cena's retirement tour. Copeland previously revealed that while he and Cena would have liked to face each other one more time, their respective contracts with AEW and WWE made it impossible, though he believed Khan would have given his blessing. Khan confirmed to the press that he was never formally approached about the cross-promotional idea, but emphasized that he has been collaborative in the past and would have backed the plan.

stories.title: Britt Baker comments on potential AEW return at All In
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Britt Baker recently fueled speculation about her professional wrestling future by cryptically responding same to a fan on social media who wished for her return at the upcoming All In event at Wembley Stadium. Baker has been absent from AEW television for nearly two years, with her last match occurring in November 2024. While fans and pundits remain eager for her comeback, her current contract is set to expire this fall, and her official return timeline remains unconfirmed by company leadership.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale suffers hand injury ahead of AEW All In
stories.tldr: AEW Womens World Champion Willow Nightingale has suffered a legitimate hand injury following a backstage attack by Mercedes Mone on Dynamite in Glasgow. Although the timing is terrible just days before their title match at Wembley Stadium, Nightingale is still expected to compete. Mone specifically targeted the injured hand during the segment, creating a dangerous new weakness for the champion to overcome. She will put her title on the line against the Owen Hart Foundation Cup winner as originally planned.

stories.title: Chris Jericho aims for AEW title match at All In
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Champion Chris Jericho has officially entered the Casino Gauntlet match for AEW All In at Wembley Stadium, setting his sights on reclaiming the promotion's top title. During a recent episode of Dynamite, Jericho announced his participation and booked a warm-up trios match for the upcoming Collision. In this upcoming bout, Jericho will team with Mike Bailey and Komander to face Tommaso Ciampa, Nick Wayne, and Mark Davis. This will be Jericho's first-ever Casino Gauntlet match, adding a new layer of danger and unpredictability as he chases another world championship opportunity.

stories.title: AEW Collision match lineups and previews
stories.tldr: AEW has finalized the match lineup and previews for this Saturday's Collision, serving as the final go-home show before the All In pay-per-view at Wembley Stadium. Taped in Glasgow, Scotland, the card features a massive 12-man tag team match alongside singles bouts like Mercedes Mone versus Isla Dawn and Konosuke Takeshita against The Beast Mortos. Several other stars, including TNT Champion Kevin Knight and Chris Jericho in six-man tag action, will compete or appear to build crucial momentum for Sunday's major event.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Glasgow taping adds women's trios match
stories.tldr: Tony Khan has added a high-stakes women's trios match to the final AEW Dynamite go-home show before All In, taped at the OVO Hydro in Glasgow, Scotland. The bout features Maya World, Alex Windsor, and Jamie Hayter colliding with Persephone, Megan Bayne, and Lena Kross. This encounter serves as a crucial preview for upcoming championship matches at Wembley Stadium, directly building the Women's Tag Team title feud and potentially setting up a TBS Championship clash.

stories.title: Adam Copeland comments on first-ever match against Young Bucks at All In
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland and Christian Cage are preparing to defend the AEW World Tag Team Championships against The Young Bucks at AEW All In at Wembley Stadium, marking a historic first-ever meeting between the two legendary tandems. Copeland recalled first noticing Matt and Nick Jackson during their TNA Generation Me days in 2010 and has since developed a deep appreciation for their distinct style of tag team wrestling. He argued that adding a stipulation to their initial encounter would be bad booking and over-complication, believing the sheer novelty of the matchup is enough to captivate fans. Furthermore, Copeland likened the generational significance of the bout to legendary cross-era sports matchups like the 1970s Steelers facing the 1990s Cowboys.

stories.title: Jim Ross comments on AEW locker room vs WWE fans
stories.tldr: Jim Ross recently sparked fresh debate by claiming that AEW features more legitimate professional wrestling fans in its locker room than WWE. Speaking on his podcast, the Hall of Famer acknowledged his bias while praising the raw passion and self-starting drive of the AEW roster. He contrasted this with WWE, suggesting the rival promotion caters more to sports-entertainment audiences. JR believes this obsession with the craft will be fully on display as the AEW roster prepares to steal the show at Wembley Stadium.

stories.title: Jim Ross suffers fall at home following brain surgery
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Jim Ross suffered a frightening fall in his bedroom just days after undergoing brain surgery to install a fluid-draining shunt. He lost his balance and crashed into a sentimental wooden bench left by his late wife, completely breaking the furniture and tearing out its screws. Fortunately, Ross avoided breaking any ribs or bones, though the violent accident highlights his ongoing equilibrium struggles that previously forced him to miss AEW All In. JR is now focusing on taking his time and relying on a walker at home to avoid further dangerous falls during his slow recovery.

stories.title: Jim Ross ruled out of attending AEW All In due to medical advice
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Jim Ross has been medically ruled out from calling matches at AEW All In at Wembley Stadium. Ross had aggressively targeted the event as his return milestone following recent brain surgery, but his doctors strictly barred him from flying due to ongoing recovery hurdles. Medical professionals warned that the risks of an in-flight emergency or being hospitalized abroad were simply too high given his current equilibrium issues, headaches, and a recent severe fall. Although deeply disappointed to miss the pay-per-view card, Ross remains focused on his rehab and plans to return to the commentary desk once he is fully healed.

stories.title: Tony Khan says non-AEW wrestlers are eager to join promotion
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan stated in a recent interview that many top professional wrestlers from outside the company are actively trying to secure spots in the promotion. While Khan acknowledged the excitement surrounding this outside interest, he also emphasized the challenge of balancing a deeply talented roster with limited television and pay-per-view spots. The comments arrive amid ongoing rumors regarding several high-profile free agents and recent talent acquisitions by the promotion.

stories.title: AEW schedule updates for HBO Max in September
stories.tldr: Warner Bros Discovery has officially revealed the HBO Max programming lineup for September, featuring a busy schedule of weekly shows and major events for All Elite Wrestling. Fans can expect regular broadcasts of Dynamite and Collision alongside special programming like Revolution and the All Out pay-per-view. Notable dates include a packed lineup on September 23 with Dynamite, a special one-hour Collision, and the Countdown to All In special. The month culminates on September 26 with the Tailgate to All Out pre-show leading directly into the All Out pay-per-view event.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Aug 26, 2026 review and match results
stories.tldr: The final episode of AEW Dynamite before All In emanated from Glasgow, Scotland, featuring a heavy wrestling showcase and key storyline developments. Staff members evaluated the pre-taped episode, weighing the frustrations of a delayed broadcast against highlights like the Swerve Strickland and Jack Perry main event. A standout segment involved MJF and Andrade nearly coming to blows ahead of their Casino Gauntlet match entry at Wembley Stadium. Overall, the show successfully built anticipation for Sunday's massive pay-per-view despite some logistical drawbacks for North American fans.

stories.title: Alex Windsor discusses The Brawling Birds ahead of AEW All In
stories.tldr: AEW stars Alex Windsor and Jamie Hayter are fully aligned as The Brawling Birds ahead of their upcoming championship match at All In: London. Windsor recently discussed their creative partnership, revealing that they constantly collaborate on character development, ring gear, and cinematic inspirations. The duo aims to project an authentic, in your face British pub aesthetic that truly reflects who they are. They will challenge Divine Dominion for the AEW Women's World Tag Team Championship at the major event.

stories.title: Match plans for AEW All In 2026
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley and Nigel McGuinness will face off in the inaugural AEW Continental Challenge Cup final at All In: London in their first singles match in over twenty years. Moxley punched his ticket by defeating Claudio Castagnoli, while McGuinness fought through an ankle injury to submit Kyle O'Reilly on Dynamite. The high-profile bout joins a massive card at Wembley Stadium featuring multiple championship matches, open challenges, and the men's Casino Gauntlet.

stories.title: Kairi Sane unlikely to appear at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Kairi Sane is currently unlikely to appear at AEW All In because she remains unsigned to any major promotion as the event rapidly approaches. Although she has received numerous global offers and enlisted a prominent agent connected to AEW, final terms are still being worked out. Industry insiders note that while time is running short, a last-minute surprise cannot be entirely ruled out.

stories.title: Jon Moxley defeats Claudio Castagnoli on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley defeated his Death Riders teammate Claudio Castagnoli in a brutal semifinal match on AEW Dynamite to reach the Continental Challenge Cup final. After enduring heavy strikes, a Curb Stomp, and a Neutralizer, Moxley ultimately made Castagnoli pass out in a suffocating Bulldog Choke. With this hard-fought victory, Moxley secures his spot in the C3 final where he will face Nigel McGuinness at AEW All In this Sunday.

stories.title: AEW All In 2026 betting odds released
stories.tldr: BetOnline has released early betting odds for AEW All In 2026 at Wembley Stadium, featuring several massive favorites heading into the August 30 event. Will Ospreay stands out as the biggest favorite on the card to dethrone AEW World Champion Kenny Omega. While most titleholders face steep odds, the TNT Championship match between Kevin Knight and Darby Allin remains an even toss-up.

stories.title: Will Ospreay claims he would still be in NJPW if not for AEW
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay recently revealed in an interview that he likely would have stayed with New Japan Pro Wrestling if All Elite Wrestling had never been created. He expressed deep gratitude for NJPW, noting how the promotion helped him grow both personally and professionally after moving to Japan at just 22 years old. Ospreay credited the Japanese organization for being patient and kind with him while he navigated cultural barriers and learned the intricacies of professional wrestling. Additionally, the former AEW International Champion discussed a past 2016 contract offer from WWE that he ultimately turned down due to low financial compensation.

stories.title: Tony Schiavone reacts to Brock Rechsteiner's NFL training camp fight
stories.tldr: AEW announcer Tony Schiavone recently reacted on his podcast to footage of Brock Rechsteiner, cousin of WWE star Bron Breakker and son of Scott Steiner, getting into a training camp fight while playing for the New Orleans Saints. Rechsteiner went viral for hitting a Dallas Cowboys player with a German Suplex during the brawl, earning praise from both Schiavone and co host Conrad Thompson. While Rechsteiner is currently pursuing a football career, analysts like Dave Meltzer speculate he may eventually transition into professional wrestling.

stories.title: Britt Baker and Rebel attend ALS Nexus 2026 conference
stories.tldr: Former AEW star Britt Baker recently attended the ALS Nexus 2026 conference in Orlando alongside her longtime friend and former onscreen ally, Tanea Brooks, widely known as Rebel. Earlier in the year, Rebel announced her diagnosis with the terminal stage of ALS, but she showed incredible strength by speaking at the event. Baker shared a heartfelt social media post praising Rebel for her resilience, enduring humor, and unwavering spirit while encouraging fans to support ALS awareness and research.

stories.title: Daily Wrestling News Update: August 27
stories.tldr: The latest daily wrestling update covers extensive news across AEW, WWE, and the broader professional wrestling landscape. Key highlights include upcoming AEW schedule updates for All Out week, Logan Paul and Bron Breakker laughing off backstage feud rumors, and various roster updates from NXT. Additionally, the latest media reports highlight Ryohei Oiwa winning the NJPW G1 Climax, WrestleMania 42 actual attendance revelations, and historical retrospectives on the Funk brothers.

stories.title: Discussion on potential first women's PPV main event in AEW
stories.tldr: AEW fans have long criticized the presentation of the women's division, making a landmark pay-per-view main event a crucial next step for the company's booking. Several potential matchups could finally break this glass ceiling, including a 60-minute iron woman match between Mercedes Mone and Willow Nightingale or a high-profile championship rematch with Toni Storm. Other possibilities feature a heated collision between Kris Statlander and Willow Nightingale, a UK-centric crowning for Jamie Hayter or Alex Windsor, or a blockbuster dream match against a potential free agent like Bayley. This discussion explores the most logical paths for AEW to book its historic first women-led pay-per-view finale.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale reflects on winning the AEW Women's World Championship
stories.tldr: As Willow Nightingale prepares to defend her AEW Women's World Championship against Mercedes Mone at AEW All In, she is reflecting on her recent title victory over Thekla at AEW Redemption. Nightingale admitted that the hectic schedule of a champion initially made it difficult to process her win, and the reality of her accomplishment only truly hit her during the following episode of Dynamite in Detroit. During that heavily praised Detroit appearance, she had to fight back tears during a face-off with Mone to avoid becoming entirely overwhelmed by her emotions.

stories.title: Tony Khan downplays Wembley pyrotechnics restrictions report
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan has downplayed recent reports suggesting the company must scale back its pyrotechnics for the upcoming All In event at Wembley Stadium. Earlier reports claimed fireworks might be restricted following a UK government wildfire warning issued during a concert by The Weeknd. However, Khan stated he was completely unaware of any such restrictions during a recent interview. Meanwhile, stadium officials defended their safety protocols and weather forecasts predict cooler temperatures by Sunday.

stories.title: AEW star reflects on being kicked out of initial training school
stories.tldr: AEW star Will Ospreay recently reflected on his early days in professional wrestling, including being kicked out of his first wrestling school, Dropkixx Wrestling, for backyard wrestling outside the facility. Despite early setbacks, including lacking traditional academic qualifications due to his ADHD, Ospreay honed his high-flying skills at the London School of Lucha Libre. Ahead of his AEW World Championship challenge against Kenny Omega at AEW All In: London, Ospreay also discussed how Tony Khan paid for his previous neck surgery and opened up about his personal life and journey to success.

stories.title: AEW star reflects on their career legacy
stories.tldr: AEW star Adam Copeland recently discussed his perspective on career legacy as he approaches a World Tag Team Championship match at All In: London alongside Christian Cage. Despite holding a WWE Hall of Fame career with numerous championships over thirty years, Copeland does not view his scripted wrestling accomplishments as his true legacy. Instead, he believes that his real legacy is defined by his children, how he raises them as good human beings, and how he treats his friends. He maintains that professional wrestling is an entertainment job, and what he does in spandex ultimately does not matter compared to real-life relationships.

stories.title: Adam Copeland gives advice to former WWE talent joining AEW
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland recently shared valuable advice for former WWE stars making the transition to AEW based on his own experiences leaving behind a two-decade career. He encouraged wrestlers not to overthink the move, trust their instincts, and rely on the skills that got them there in the first place. Copeland also emphasized the importance of stepping out of comfortable and safe positions to embrace new challenges and fresh matchups.

stories.title: AEW 2026 pay-per-view schedule and streaming guide
stories.tldr: The 2026 AEW pay-per-view schedule outlines major events slated for the latter half of the year, including All In at Wembley Stadium and All Out in Chicago. Fans have multiple options to watch these broadcasts, ranging from streaming platforms like HBO Max and Amazon Prime to traditional cable outlets. The lineup also features WrestleDream and Full Gear, alongside other marquee annual events like Revolution, Dynasty, Double or Nothing, Forbidden Door, and Redemption.

stories.title: Adam Copeland shares his rule for judging match quality
stories.tldr: AEW star Adam Copeland revealed that his primary metric for judging wrestling match quality is the live crowd reaction during the finish, specifically whether fans count along with a babyface victory or boo a heel win. During an interview with Forbes, the veteran of over three decades emphasized that ticket-buying fans in the arena matter most, dismissing online critics and technical perfection in favor of emotional investment and storytelling. Copeland also noted that this philosophy developed over time alongside his realization that his own enjoyment in the ring directly translates to the audience having a good time.

stories.title: Adam Copeland discusses tag team dynamic with Christian Cage
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland recently discussed his AEW tag team reunion with longtime friend Christian Cage, highlighting their milestone tag title win at Double or Nothing 25 years after their first championship run. Instead of relying on nostalgia, the veterans focused on blending their current individual characters into a fresh dynamic. Copeland noted that their new roles feature him playing the straight man while Cage acts as the curmudgeon, creating a completely different chemistry than their previous runs in the year 2000.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher discusses pursuing AEW World Championship
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher has made it clear that winning the AEW World Championship is a major long-term goal for his career. However, his immediate focus remains on defending his International Title in a high-stakes triple threat match against Konosuke Takeshita and Kazuchika Okada at All In. Fletcher also acknowledged massive bouts like Kenny Omega versus Will Ospreay while emphasizing that professional wrestling is all about timing and positioning. Having previously challenged Hangman Page for the world title, Fletcher ultimately envisions himself as the face and future of the promotion for decades to come.

stories.title: Speculation on Ilja Dragunov joining AEW following WWE departure
stories.tldr: Following his departure from WWE, heavy speculation suggests Ilja Dragunov could make a surprise debut for All Elite Wrestling at the upcoming All In event in London. Analysts are eyeing the Men's Casino Gauntlet match as the ideal spot for his arrival to position him immediately near the top of the card. Meanwhile, AEW International Champion Kyle Fletcher has publicly expressed his excitement about the prospect of reigniting their past rivalry.

stories.title: AEW All In 2026 match card and event coverage
stories.tldr: As AEW All In approaches this weekend at Wembley Stadium, the finalized match card features several high-profile championship bouts including Jon Moxley versus Nigel McGuinness and multiple multi-man encounters. Speculation also surrounds potential last-minute additions, while ticket distribution figures hovering around 42,000 reflect a cooling novelty and broader economic pressures compared to previous UK events.

stories.title: AEW announces TV schedule adjustments for All Out week
stories.tldr: Building on the previously announced back-to-back Dynamite and Collision tapings for All Out week, additional programming details have emerged. The September Indianapolis block will also feature a late-night countdown special and the return of the Tailgate Brawl pre-show on TNT. Furthermore, AEW has announced several new October event dates and detailed upcoming classic content additions for HBO Max.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton releases rap track with Lil Yachty
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown star Tiffany Stratton recently surprised fans by stepping into the recording booth with rapper Lil Yachty during his August 26 Twitch stream. The pair collaborated on an unexpected hip-hop track featuring Stratton delivering confident bars about her appearance, financial success, and relentless pursuit of championship gold. Incorporating her signature Tiffy Time catchphrase into the lyrics, the crossover collaboration quickly went viral across social media. While it remains unconfirmed if the song will get an official release or end up on WWE television, the impromptu session has generated significant buzz among wrestling fans.

stories.title: Logan Paul and Bron Breakker address rumors of backstage issues
stories.tldr: Former WWE talent Jonathan Coachman recently sparked a rumor claiming that Bron Breakker and Logan Paul were experiencing backstage tension and did not get along. Both wrestlers have strongly and publicly debunked these claims, with Breakker laughing off the report as clickbait during a recent backstage vlog. The two stablemates have made it clear that there is no truth to the rumors, expressing amusement at the fabricated weekly narratives.

stories.title: TKO becomes minority shareholder in DAZN streaming platform
stories.tldr: TKO Group Holdings, the parent company of WWE and UFC, has become a minority shareholder in the sports streaming platform DAZN following DAZN's acquisition of EverPass Media. EverPass was originally founded by the NFL investment arm 32 Equity and RedBird Capital Partners, with TKO having previously invested in EverPass back in 2024. As part of this new deal, TKO, RedBird, and the NFL all transition into minority stakeholders in the combined DAZN and EverPass entity. The acquisition allows DAZN to expand its commercial footprint in the United States by leveraging EverPass infrastructure for distributing live sports to bars, hotels, and restaurants.

stories.title: Natalya reflects on WWE career and Vince McMahon limiting opportunities
stories.tldr: WWE veteran Natalya recently opened up about her career, expressing frustration that former chairman Vince McMahon would have limited her current outside opportunities. She praised current leadership under Nick Khan and Triple H for allowing her to work promotions like Bloodsport, GCW, NWA, and AAA for personal growth. Additionally, Natalya discussed her future aspirations behind the scenes in WWE and her ongoing work in NXT. She notably praised rising star Jaida Parker, dubbing her the female Jacob Fatu ahead of their upcoming Submission Match at NXT Heatwave.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown TV ratings and viewership updates
stories.tldr: The August 21, 2026 episode of WWE SmackDown on USA Network experienced a slight increase in both viewership and key demographic ratings compared to the previous week. Data shows the show drew 1,280,000 viewers with a 0.32 rating in the 18 to 49 demographic, up from 1,247,000 viewers and a 0.3 rating the week prior. Year-over-year figures showed a 1.7 percent increase in total viewership despite an 8.6 percent drop in the demo compared to the same week in 2025. Additionally, digital engagement remained strong with top YouTube videos drawing hundreds of thousands of views.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano apologizes for accidental injuries caused on WWE RAW
stories.tldr: Recently released wrestling star Zoey Serrano launched a new digital series called Zoey 101 to answer fan questions about her career. During the premiere episode, she addressed two regrettable incidents from her time on WWE Raw where opponents were accidentally injured. Serrano expressed deep remorse for breaking Katana Chance's nose in 2024 and causing a concussion and memory loss for Dakota Kai during a tag team match in January 2025. She emphasized the sacred trust between in-ring performers and apologized profusely to both women for the mishaps.

stories.title: Natalya praises NXT star Jaida Parker
stories.tldr: WWE veteran Natalya recently revealed that she personally requested WWE management to let her work on the NXT brand specifically to feud with rising star Jaida Parker. During a recent interview, Natalya praised Parker's unique intensity and work ethic, even comparing her to Raw star Jacob Fatu by calling her a female version of him. The two competitors are now scheduled to settle their ongoing rivalry in a high-stakes submission match at NXT Heatwave.

stories.title: Logan Paul recovery from triceps injury
stories.tldr: Logan Paul is making significant progress in his recovery from a severe triceps injury sustained earlier this year while wrestling The Street Profits. During a recent visit to Dr. Dugas featured on his YouTube channel, Paul learned that his arm is healing well and he is now considered semi-cleared to resume certain physical activities. He has already taken his updated status backstage to Monday Night Raw, sharing the news with WWE officials including Bruce Prichard and Triple H.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes visits Marvel Studios
stories.tldr: WWE star Cody Rhodes recently shared a photo from inside Marvel Studios on his Instagram Story, sparking widespread speculation among fans about a potential acting role in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. While Rhodes provided no details and neither he nor Marvel has confirmed any casting, fans have already begun fantasy-casting him as various comic book characters including Bastion, William Stryker, Havok, Nova, or a Captain America variant. Rhodes has long expressed a desire to transition into major acting roles similar to fellow wrestling legends Dwayne Johnson, John Cena, and Dave Bautista, having previously auditioned for Black Bolt and expressed interest in playing the X-Men character Cable.

stories.title: Hulk Hogan's WrestleMania 2 championship belt sold at auction
stories.tldr: Hulk Hogan's iconic WWF World Heavyweight Championship belt from WrestleMania 2 recently sold at a Heritage Auctions event for a staggering $414,800. The classic globe-design title was photo-matched to the historic 1986 event, where Hogan successfully defended the championship against King Kong Bundy inside a steel cage. According to auction records, Hogan originally gifted the belt backstage to the son of a close family friend, and it remained in that family's possession for decades before heading to the auction block.

stories.title: Santos Escobar advocates for more Latino writers and producers in WWE
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Santos Escobar, now performing as Romeo Malverde, recently advocated for the promotion to hire more Latino writers and producers to authentically represent Hispanic culture. In an interview with Denise Salcedo, Escobar emphasized that only those within the community truly understand how to approach the valuable Latino demographic. Additionally, Escobar reflected on his brief departure from WWE last year, revealing to TMZ Sports that a personal phone call and apology from Nick Khan regarding his character's direction led directly to his decision to re-sign.

stories.title: New WWE Superstar debuting with unique gimmick
stories.tldr: A new WWE developmental star named Vanta The Unknown is preparing for her televised in-ring debut on WWE Evolve with a striking dark gimmick and facepaint. Portrayed by Russian gymnast and pole dancer Jessica Bogdanov, the character has already been tested at untelevised NXT live events against names like Nikkita Lyons. Her recent promos promise a psychological and intense presence, aiming to stand out from the typical roster naming conventions without leaning too far into supernatural territory.

stories.title: Cruz Montana names retired wrestler as dream opponent
stories.tldr: WWE NXT star Cruz Montana recently revealed that his ultimate dream match would have been against AJ Styles, who retired from in-ring competition at the 2026 Royal Rumble. The two nearly crossed paths during the recent WWE and TNA partnership, but the cross-promotional bout ultimately never came together. In addition to Styles, Montana is eager to step into the ring with active WWE stars like Cody Rhodes and CM Punk, both of whom he previously worked with in AEW. Currently, Montana is focused on his upcoming opportunity as he prepares to challenge for the NXT Championship at NXT Heatwave.

stories.title: Natalya says she wants to train Logan Paul at the Hart Dungeon
stories.tldr: WWE veteran Natalya recently extended an invitation to Logan Paul to train at the famous Hart Dungeon alongside her husband TJ Wilson and other top talent. Speaking with TMZ Inside The Ring, Natalya praised Paul's dedication to the wrestling business, noting his recent efforts to attend shows despite a serious arm injury. She believes that putting him through the rigorous Dungeon training sessions could help him elevate his in-ring skills to the next level. Paul recently provided an update on his recovery, stating he is currently semi-cleared for an in-ring return.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano reveals contract offers from WWE and TNA
stories.tldr: Zoey Serrano, formerly known in WWE as Zoey Stark, recently shared that she received simultaneous contract offers from both WWE and TNA Wrestling early in her career. Although she ultimately chose to sign with WWE in January 2021, she credited her previous television exposure working as Lacey Ryan in TNA for helping her get noticed by WWE scouts. Her career has since featured an NXT Women's Tag Team Championship reign, a main roster run alongside Shayna Baszler, and prominent programs with stars like Trish Stratus and Becky Lynch. Following a knee injury and her subsequent departure from WWE, Serrano recently made her in-ring return at RevPro's Women's Grand Prix.

stories.title: Dawn Marie details past firing from WWE during pregnancy
stories.tldr: Former ECW and WWE star Dawn Marie recently opened up about being abruptly fired by WWE years ago due to her pregnancy, noting she was the first woman under contract to experience this. Despite the lingering trauma and a difficult recent NXT guest referee appearance that brought back old pain, she ultimately found closure from the situation. Today, she has completely transitioned away from wrestling to work as a nurse, run a crystal store, and manage an OnlyFans account to secure her future.

stories.title: Triple H celebrates 50th anniversary of Motörhead
stories.tldr: WWE Chief Content Officer Paul Triple H Levesque recently paid tribute to the legendary rock band Motorhead and his late friend Ian Lemmy Kilmister in honor of the group's 50th anniversary. Taking to social media, Levesque showcased new anniversary merchandise while remembering the band that famously performed his entrance themes at multiple WrestleMania events. The two shared a deep personal and professional bond until Lemmy's passing in 2015, with Lemmy later crediting the wrestling star for introducing their music to a whole new generation of fans.

stories.title: WWE Evolve talent reportedly heading to main roster
stories.tldr: WWE Evolve has emerged as a pre-NXT developmental show streaming weekly on Tubi, serving as a breeding ground for talent that could potentially bypass NXT entirely. Five specific developmental prospects, including Brooks Jensen, Kale Dixon, PJ Vasa, Harlem Lewis, and Elijah Holyfield, have been identified as strong candidates to make the direct jump to the main roster. Factors such as backstage praise, international excursions, unique character styles, and main roster dark matches have positioned these athletes to skip the traditional developmental television route.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman discusses WWE Radio departure
stories.tldr: Jonathan Coachman recently discussed his departure from hosting Off The Ropes after his radio channel was transformed into official WWE Radio. Although he was not given an official reason for the change, Coachman believes losing the role ultimately benefits his credibility. He argued that staying with an officially branded WWE platform would have forced him to praise every creative decision and risk looking like a fraud to fans. Coachman is now focused on building independent programming where he can maintain honest and balanced commentary.

stories.title: Bully Ray discusses potential WWE return for Saturday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Bully Ray recently discussed the high-stakes match between Bron Breakker and Oba Femi, noting the creative dilemma of not wanting either rising star to suffer a loss. Speaking on Busted Open Radio, he suggested that Bronson Reed could interfere in the match to stake his own claim as the true future of WWE while aligning with Paul Heyman. This outside interference would protect both competitors by allowing Breakker to win after a chaotic sequence while shielding Femi with sympathy as a babyface.
