Bully Ray and co-host Dave LaGreca also explored how Reed would benefit the most from Heyman's management, contrasting him with Breakker and Femi who possess qualities that make managers unnecessary.

stories.title: Santos Escobar confirms he will not reprise El Hijo del Fantasma gimmick
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Romeo Malverde, formerly known as Santos Escobar, has officially stated that he will not bring back his El Hijo del Fantasma persona. He believes in advancing rather than looking backward and is currently taking his time before returning to the active wrestling scene. Alongside preparing for his next chapter in the industry, Malverde is also pursuing various acting opportunities.

stories.title: Roman Reigns sends message ahead of RAW title defense in Mexico City
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns has issued a public challenge on social media ahead of his World Heavyweight Championship defense on September 14 in Mexico City. The upcoming title match will feature the winner of a high-stakes tournament involving top luchadors, which has boiled down to a final match between real-life brothers Penta and Rey Fenix. This tournament has offered a refreshing change of pace for Reigns and his limited schedule, even though a title change appears unlikely given his current overarching storylines with other top stars.

stories.title: Santos Escobar reflects on lessons learned during WWE career
stories.tldr: Former WWE wrestler Jorge Bolly, who performed as Santos Escobar, reflects on the valuable lessons he learned from legendary coaches and peers during his time with the company despite being released following WrestleMania 42. Now competing under the new name Romeo Malverde, he is blending his past experiences as Escobar, El Hijo del Fantasma, and King Cuerno into a more mature and profitable persona. He credits veterans like Shawn Michaels, Triple H, Rey Mysterio, and others for shaping his current wrestling mindset as he prepares for his next career chapter.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman claims ESPN bias against wrestling led to pay cut
stories.tldr: Jonathan Coachman recently discussed his career transition from WWE to ESPN, revealing that institutional bias against professional wrestling severely impacted his earnings. He claims an unnamed network executive who despised his wrestling background forced a sixty thousand dollar yearly salary cut and later slashed his pay by one hundred twenty thousand dollars total on a second deal. That second agreement was negotiated by current WWE President Nick Khan, whom the executive falsely accused Coachman of trash-talking. Coachman now regrets accepting the pay cuts without a fight and views the ordeal as a harsh lesson in self-advocacy.

stories.title: WON Flashback: WWE SummerSlam 2007 review
stories.tldr: This WON flashback reviews WWE SummerSlam 2007, a poorly received event featuring one of the worst matches in PPV history. Dave Meltzer famously gave Batista versus The Great Khali a negative one and a half star rating, highlighted by his sarcastic quip that he liked the finish simply because it meant the match was over. Despite the heavy criticism, fan backlash, and notorious nerve holds, the historic bout has surprisingly accumulated 13 million views on YouTube over the years.

stories.title: WWE NXT TV ratings and viewership updates
stories.tldr: Following the final preparations for Heatwave, the August 18 episode of NXT saw a notable rebound in audience metrics. Wrestlenomics reported that viewership rose to 683,000 viewers with a 0.14 rating in the key 18 to 49 demographic. This marks a significant increase from the previous week's 588,000 viewers and 0.09 demo rating.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano opens up about career and WWE run on Twitter Q&A
stories.tldr: Alongside her previous remarks about being blocked from a Chris Bey benefit, Zoey Serrano has launched a new Twitter and X series called Zoey 101. In the first episode, the former WWE star answered fan questions about wrestling myths, bathroom accidents, and online trolls. She candidly discussed everything from passing gas in the ring to dealing with harsh internet insults.

stories.title: AJ Styles reacts to Ilja Dragunov leaving WWE
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently addressed Ilja Dragunov's departure from WWE on his podcast, admitting he is completely in the dark about the situation despite working for the company. Styles expressed genuine sadness over losing a talent he deeply enjoys watching, echoing the surprise felt by many fans. Meanwhile, speculation continues to grow regarding Dragunov's next move, with analysts heavily anticipating a potential debut in AEW in the near future.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman criticizes lack of WWE house show testing
stories.tldr: Following recent backlash over his Raw segment, Joe Hendry's controversial concert has drawn further criticism from industry veteran Jonathan Coachman. Coachman argued that WWE's heavily reduced house-show schedule deprived talent of a crucial testing ground for creative ideas. He claimed that live event trials would have easily exposed the segment as terrible and led to it being scrapped entirely.

stories.title: TNA Impact TV ratings and viewership drops
stories.tldr: TNA Impact experienced a viewership and ratings decline for the August 20, 2026 episode on AMC, dropping below the 200,000 viewer threshold for the second consecutive week. Total viewership fell to 188,000, while the key 18-49 demographic rating took a steep 50 percent hit down to 0.02. This downward trend arrives despite the episode serving as the final television build for the Lockdown pay-per-view event featuring prominent acts like The Hardys.

stories.title: Drake Maverick returning to the ring for PROGRESS Wrestling
stories.tldr: Rockstar Spud, widely known to WWE fans as Drake Maverick, is scheduled to make a surprising in-ring return for PROGRESS Wrestling after nearly five years away from the squared circle. The 43-year-old, who currently works behind the scenes on the WWE Raw creative team, will wrestle on September 12 in Bournemouth and September 13 in Birmingham as part of the company Odyssey Tour. This marks his first match in 1,769 days, with his last official bout taking place in November 2021 before his release from WWE. PROGRESS Wrestling has also made headlines by booking Malakai Black for multiple matches during the tour and confirming that the promotion was recently acquired by former WWE stars Nikki Cross and Killian Dain.

stories.title: AAA announces contender matches for Ola de Calor
stories.tldr: AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio has announced a high-stakes triple threat match between Jack Cartwheel, Nathan Frazer, and Mini Vikingo for the upcoming Ola de Calor event on August 30, 2026. The winner will immediately become the number one contender for the AAA Latin American Championship, setting up a clash against whoever survives the vacant title four-way match that same night. The stacked card at the Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, also features tag team title action, a major six-man tag, a Reina de Reinas contender gauntlet, and El Carnicero's debut.

stories.title: Bret Hart to receive Lou Thesz Award from Cauliflower Alley Club
stories.tldr: The Cauliflower Alley Club has announced that wrestling legend Bret Hart will receive the prestigious 2026 Lou Thesz Award. Known as the Excellence of Execution, Hart is being recognized for his unmatched in-ring precision, storytelling, and lasting impact on the industry. Adding a special family touch to the milestone, last year's recipient Natalya Neidhart will present the award to him. The presentation will take place during the landmark CAC 60: The Diamond Anniversary Reunion in Las Vegas.

stories.title: Wrestling News Rumor Roundup: Aug. 27, 2026
stories.tldr: This rumor roundup covers major updates ahead of AEW All In at Wembley Stadium, including backstage status reports on Kairi Sane and Thekla, alongside betting odds for the match card. The report also addresses recent discussions regarding a retracted ESPN and WWE story, Tony Khan comments on a potential John Cena and Adam Copeland match, and the strategic reasons behind AEW television overruns. Additionally, indie standout VertVixen has reportedly signed an AEW and Ring of Honor contract.

stories.title: Gail Kim calls out BJ Bethel over retracted WWE-ESPN report
stories.tldr: Gail Kim expressed no sympathy for a fired reporter following the retraction of a fabricated story claiming a major network would not renew its WWE deal. Kim revealed she had previously been the target of the reporter's fabricated articles regarding a supposed interest in joining AEW. The controversy has raised serious questions about editorial oversight and accountability within the publishing platform. This incident highlights a broader pattern of credibility issues that went unchecked until a major corporate denial forced the outlet's hand.

stories.title: After Dark Radio discussing mental health topics
stories.tldr: After Dark Radio hosted by Bryan Alvarez recently featured a special appearance by Dr. Tom Nehmy to discuss several significant mental health and therapeutic topics. The episode focused on Induced After Death Communication as a method for grief healing and explored the mainstream rise of EMDR eye movement therapy. Additionally, the conversation included compelling stories of clients communicating with departed loved ones, making for an engaging and informative broadcast.

stories.title: Dana White reacts to Bella Mir loss on Contender Series
stories.tldr: UFC President Dana White recently confessed to being extremely biased heading into the latest episode of the Contender Series where Bella Mir suffered a shocking defeat against Alex Apodaca. Mir, the daughter of UFC legend Frank Mir and a massive betting favorite, lost via a unanimous decision as Apodaca pulled off a massive upset with +1200 odds to earn a UFC contract. White praised Mir for surviving the deep water despite her lack of experience in that area and noted that this tough loss serves as a valuable learning experience for her budding career.

stories.title: Retro Pro Wrestling History: September 1986
stories.tldr: Karl Stern’s latest DragonKingKarl Show looks back at the major professional wrestling events of September 1986. The episode covers the legal outcome for Chris Adams, who received a slap on the wrist following a criminal case, was stripped of the World Class World title, and subsequently jumped to Bill Watts’ UWF promotion. Meanwhile, World Class crowned a new World champion who made a memorable entrance riding a literal horse, and the World Wrestling Federation significantly expanded its television footprint by debuting two new weekly shows, Superstars and Wrestling Challenge.

stories.title: Top 10 wrestling matches in history on August 26
stories.tldr: August 26 has historically hosted numerous classic professional wrestling matches across global promotions. A 1997 encounter between Hiroshi Hase and Kenta Kobashi holds the number one spot according to Cagematch user ratings. The date also features acclaimed bouts like Shingo Takagi versus Will Ospreay, which earned high praise and a five-star rating from Dave Meltzer. This compilation highlights the diverse array of legendary encounters that have taken place on this specific calendar day.

stories.title: TNA Impact broadcast time and previews
stories.tldr: Tonight's episode of TNA Impact airs live on AMC from the CAA Centre in Brampton, Ontario, featuring the finals of the Knockouts TV Title Tournament between M by Elegance and Jada Stone. The broadcast will also include Bear Bronson going one-on-one against Elijah and an appearance by Indi Hartwell. Global start times have been released for fans tuning in around the world, ranging from prime time in North America to early morning hours internationally.

stories.title: Sherilyn Guerrero provides update on her pro wrestling training
stories.tldr: Sherilyn Guerrero, daughter of the legendary Eddie Guerrero, is actively training for a professional wrestling career and has previously expressed interest in facing Mercedes Mone. In a new interview update, Sherilyn shared that her in-ring debut is approaching and that she is thoroughly enjoying the training process. She also revealed specific moves she plans to use, including her father's iconic Three Amigos and Liv Morgan's ObLIVion finisher.
